units.en: Abstract
units.zh: 摘要

units.en: Today’s denoising diffusion models do not “denoise” in the classical sense, *i.e* . , they do not directly predict clean images. Rather, the neural networks predict noise or a noised quantity. In this paper, we suggest that predicting clean data and predicting noised quantities are fundamentally different. According to the manifold assumption, natural data should lie on a low-dimensional manifold, whereas noised quantities do not. With this assumption, we advocate for models that directly predict clean data, which allows apparently under-capacity networks to operate effectively in very high-dimensional spaces. We show that simple, large-patch Transformers on pixels can be strong generative models: using no tokenizer, no pre-training, and no extra loss. Our approach is conceptually nothing more than “ Just image Transformers ”, or JiT , as we call it. We report competitive results using JiT with large patch sizes of 16 and 32 on ImageNet at resolutions of 256 and 512, where predicting high-dimensional noised quantities can fail catastrophically. With our networks mapping back to the basics of the manifold, our research goes back to basics and pursues a self-contained paradigm for Transformer-based diffusion on raw natural data.
units.zh: 如今的去噪扩散模型并不在经典意义上“去噪”，即它们并不直接预测干净图像。相反，神经网络预测的是噪声或某种加噪后的量。本文认为，预测干净数据与预测加噪量在本质上是不同的。依据流形假设，自然数据应当位于一个低维流形上，而加噪量不是。基于这一假设，我们主张采用直接预测干净数据的模型；这使得表面上看容量不足的网络也能在极高维空间中有效工作。我们表明，仅作用于像素、使用大图块的简单 Transformer 就可以是强生成模型：不用 tokenizer、不做预训练、不加额外损失。我们的方法在概念上不过是“**Just image Transformers**”，即我们所称的 **JiT**。我们在 ImageNet 上以 256 和 512 的分辨率、16 和 32 的大图块尺寸报告了有竞争力的结果；在同样的设置下，预测高维加噪量可能灾难性失败。通过让网络回到流形这一根本，我们的研究回到根本，追求一种在原始自然数据上做 Transformer 扩散的自包含范式。

units.en: 1 Introduction
units.zh: 1 引言

units.en: When diffusion generative models were first developed [ [57](#bib.bib4) , [59](#bib.bib5) , [23](#bib.bib3) ] , the core idea was supposed to be denoising , *i.e* . , predicting a clean image from its corrupted version. However, two significant milestones in the evolution of diffusion models turned out to deviate from the goal of directly predicting clean images. First, predicting the noise itself (known as “ $\bm{\epsilon}$ -prediction”) [ [23](#bib.bib3) ] made a pivotal difference in generation quality and largely popularized these models. Later, diffusion models were connected to flow-based methods [ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ] through predicting the flow velocity (“ $\bm{v}$ -prediction ” [ [52](#bib.bib27) ] ), a quantity that combines clean data and noise. Today, diffusion models in practice commonly predict noise or a noised quantity ( *e.g* . , velocity).
units.zh: 扩散生成模型最初被提出时[ [57](#bib.bib4) , [59](#bib.bib5) , [23](#bib.bib3) ]，其核心思想本应是去噪，即从受损版本预测干净图像。然而，扩散模型演化过程中的两个重要里程碑偏离了直接预测干净图像这一目标。首先，直接预测噪声本身（即“$\bm{\epsilon}$-预测”）[ [23](#bib.bib3) ]在生成质量上带来了关键差异，并在很大程度上让这类模型流行起来。后来，扩散模型通过预测流速度（即“$\bm{v}$-预测”[ [52](#bib.bib27) ]，一个结合了干净数据与噪声的量）与基于流的方法[ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ]建立了联系。今天，实践中使用的扩散模型通常预测噪声或某种加噪量（例如速度）。

units.en: Figure 1 : The Manifold Assumption [ [4](#bib.bib32) ] hypothesizes that natural images lie on a low-dimensional manifold within the high-dimensional pixel space. While a clean image $\bm{x}$ can be modeled as on-manifold, the noise $\bm{\epsilon}$ or flow velocity $\bm{v}$ ( *e.g* . , $\bm{v}=\bm{x}-\bm{\epsilon}$ ) is inherently off-manifold. Training a neural network to predict a clean image ( *i.e* . , $\bm{x}$ -prediction) is fundamentally different from training it to predict noise or a noised quantity ( *i.e* . , $\bm{\epsilon}$ / $\bm{v}$ -prediction).
units.zh: 图 1：流形假设 [4](#bib.bib32) 认为自然图像位于高维像素空间中的一个低维流形上。干净图像 $\bm{x}$ 可以建模为位于流形之上，而噪声 $\bm{\epsilon}$ 或流速度 $\bm{v}$（例如 $\bm{v}=\bm{x}-\bm{\epsilon}$）本质上位于流形之外。训练神经网络预测干净图像（即 $\bm{x}$-预测），与训练它预测噪声或含噪量（即 $\bm{\epsilon}$/$\bm{v}$-预测）有本质区别。

units.en: Extensive studies [ [52](#bib.bib27) , [29](#bib.bib30) , [25](#bib.bib17) , [15](#bib.bib31) ] have shown that predicting the clean image (“ $\bm{x}$ -prediction ” [ [52](#bib.bib27) ] ) is closely related to $\bm{\epsilon}$ - and $\bm{v}$ -prediction, provided that the weighting of the prediction loss is reformulated accordingly (detailed in [Sec. 3](#S3) ). Owing to this relation, less attention has been paid to what the network should directly predict, implicitly assuming that the network is capable of performing the assigned task.
units.zh: 大量研究[ [52](#bib.bib27) , [29](#bib.bib30) , [25](#bib.bib17) , [15](#bib.bib31) ]已经表明，预测干净图像（“$\bm{x}$-预测”[ [52](#bib.bib27) ]）与 $\bm{\epsilon}$-预测、$\bm{v}$-预测密切相关，前提是相应地重新表述预测损失的加权方式（详见[第 3 节](#S3)）。由于存在这种关系，人们较少关注网络究竟应当直接预测什么，而是隐含地假定网络有能力完成被指派的任务。

units.en: However, the roles of clean images and a noised quantity (including the noise itself) are not equal. In machine learning, it has long been hypothesized [ [4](#bib.bib32) , [3](#bib.bib42) ] that “(high-dimensional) data lie (roughly) on a low-dimensional manifold” ( [ [4](#bib.bib32) , p.6] ). Under this manifold assumption, while clean data can be modeled as lying on a low-dimensional manifold, a noised quantity is inherently distributed across the full high-dimensional space [ [69](#bib.bib33) ] (see [Fig. 1](#S1.F1) ). Predicting clean data is fundamentally different from predicting noise or a noised quantity.
units.zh: 然而，干净图像与加噪量（包括噪声本身）的角色并不对等。在机器学习中，长期存在这样一个假设[ [4](#bib.bib32) , [3](#bib.bib42) ]：“（高维）数据（大致）位于一个低维流形上”（[ [4](#bib.bib32) , p.6]）。在这一流形假设下，干净数据可以被建模为位于低维流形上，而加噪量本质上分布在整个高维空间中[ [69](#bib.bib33) ]（见[图 1](#S1.F1)）。预测干净数据与预测噪声或加噪量有根本区别。

units.en: Consider a scenario where a low-dimensional manifold is embedded in a high-dimensional observation space. Predicting noise in this high-dimensional space requires high capacity : the network needs to preserve all information about the noise. In contrast, a limited-capacity network can still predict the clean data, as it only needs to retain the low-dimensional information while filtering out the noise.
units.zh: 设想这样一个情形：一个低维流形嵌入在高维观测空间之中。在这个高维空间里预测噪声需要**高容量**：网络必须保留关于噪声的全部信息。相反，容量有限的网络仍然可以预测干净数据，因为它只需要保留低维信息，同时把噪声滤除。

units.en: When a low-dimensional space ( *e.g* . , image latent [ [49](#bib.bib7) ] ) is used, the difficulty of predicting noise is alleviated, yet at the same time is hidden rather than solved. When it comes to pixel or other high-dimensional spaces, existing diffusion models can still struggle to address the curse of dimensionality [ [4](#bib.bib32) ] . The heavy reliance on a pre-trained latent space prevents diffusion models from being self-contained.
units.zh: 当使用低维空间（例如图像潜变量[ [49](#bib.bib7) ]）时，预测噪声的难度得到缓解，但这一难度同时是被隐藏、而非被解决。一旦涉及像素或其他高维空间，现有扩散模型仍可能难以应对维数灾难[ [4](#bib.bib32) ]。对预训练潜空间的重度依赖使扩散模型无法自包含。

units.en: In pursuit of a self-contained principle, there has been strong focus on advancing diffusion modeling in the pixel space [ [7](#bib.bib39) , [25](#bib.bib17) , [26](#bib.bib26) , [6](#bib.bib38) , [70](#bib.bib54) ] . In general, these methods explicitly or implicitly avoid the information bottleneck in the networks, *e.g* . , by using dense convolutions or smaller patches, increasing channels, or adding long skip connections. We suggest that these designs may stem from the demand to predict high-dimensional noised quantities.
units.zh: 为了追求自包含这一原则，像素空间中的扩散建模受到了高度重视[ [7](#bib.bib39) , [25](#bib.bib17) , [26](#bib.bib26) , [6](#bib.bib38) , [70](#bib.bib54) ]。总体而言，这些方法以显式或隐式的方式避开网络中的信息瓶颈，例如使用密集卷积或更小的图块、增加通道数、或加入长跳跃连接。我们认为，这些设计可能源自预测高维加噪量的需求。

units.en: In this paper, we return to first principles and let the neural network directly predict the clean image. By doing so, we show that a plain Vision Transformer (ViT) [ [13](#bib.bib8) ] , operating on large image patches consisting of raw pixels, can be effective for diffusion modeling. Our approach is self-contained and does not rely on any pre-training or auxiliary loss — no latent tokenizer [ [49](#bib.bib7) ] , no adversarial loss [ [16](#bib.bib11) , [49](#bib.bib7) ] , no perceptual loss [ [77](#bib.bib34) , [49](#bib.bib7) ] (thus no pre-trained classifier [ [56](#bib.bib36) ] ), and no representation alignment [ [74](#bib.bib35) ] (thus no self-supervised pre-training [ [45](#bib.bib37) ] ) . Conceptually, our model is nothing more than “Just image Transformers”, or JiT , as we call it, applied to diffusion.
units.zh: 本文回到第一性原理，让神经网络直接预测干净图像。由此我们表明，一个朴素的 Vision Transformer（ViT）[ [13](#bib.bib8) ]，在由原始像素组成的大图块上运行，就可以有效地进行扩散建模。我们的方法自包含，不依赖任何预训练或辅助损失——没有潜变量 tokenizer[ [49](#bib.bib7) ]，没有对抗损失[ [16](#bib.bib11) , [49](#bib.bib7) ]，没有感知损失[ [77](#bib.bib34) , [49](#bib.bib7) ]（因而没有预训练分类器[ [56](#bib.bib36) ]），也没有表征对齐[ [74](#bib.bib35) ]（因而没有自监督预训练[ [45](#bib.bib37) ]）。在概念上，我们的模型不过就是把“Just image Transformers”（我们称之为 JiT）用于扩散。

units.en: We conduct experiments on the ImageNet dataset [ [11](#bib.bib9) ] at resolutions of 256 and 512, using JiT models with patch sizes 16 and 32 respectively. Even though the patches are very high-dimensional (hundreds or thousands), our models using $\bm{x}$ -prediction can easily produce strong results, where $\bm{\epsilon}$ - and $\bm{v}$ -prediction fail catastrophically. Further analysis shows that it is unnecessary for the network width to match or exceed the patch dimension; in fact, and surprisingly, a bottleneck design can even be beneficial, echoing observations from classical manifold learning.
units.zh: 我们在 ImageNet 数据集[ [11](#bib.bib9) ]上进行实验，分辨率分别为 256 和 512，使用图块尺寸分别为 16 和 32 的 JiT 模型。尽管图块维度非常高（数百或数千维），我们使用 $\bm{x}$-预测的模型仍能轻松取得强结果，而 $\bm{\epsilon}$-预测与 $\bm{v}$-预测在此情形下灾难性失败。进一步的分析表明，网络宽度并不需要匹配或超过图块维度；事实上，出乎意料的是，瓶颈设计甚至可能有益，这与经典流形学习中的观察相呼应。

units.en: Our effort marks a step toward a self-contained “Diffusion + Transformer” philosophy [ [46](#bib.bib12) ] on native data. Beyond computer vision, this philosophy is highly desirable in other domains involving natural data ( *e.g* . , proteins, molecules, or weather), where a tokenizer can be difficult to design. By minimizing domain-specific designs, we hope that the general “Diffusion + Transformer” paradigm originated from computer vision will find broader applicability.
units.zh: 我们的工作是在原生数据上迈向自包含的“Diffusion + Transformer”理念[ [46](#bib.bib12) ]的一步。除计算机视觉之外，这一理念在涉及自然数据的其他领域（例如蛋白质、分子或天气）中也极具吸引力，因为这些领域中 tokenizer 难以设计。通过尽量减少领域特定的设计，我们希望源自计算机视觉的通用“Diffusion + Transformer”范式能找到更广泛的应用。

units.en: 2 Related Work
units.zh: 2 相关工作

units.en: Diffusion Models and Their Predictions.
units.zh: 扩散模型及其预测。

units.en: The pioneering work on diffusion models [ [57](#bib.bib4) ] proposed to learn a reversed stochastic process, in which the network predicts the parameters of a normal distribution ( *e.g* . , mean and standard deviation). Five years after its introduction, this method was revitalized and popularized by Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM) [ [23](#bib.bib3) ] : a pivotal discovery was to make noise the prediction target ( *i.e* . , $\bm{\epsilon}$ -prediction).
units.zh: 扩散模型的开创性工作[ [57](#bib.bib4) ]提出学习一个逆向随机过程，其中网络预测正态分布的参数（例如均值与标准差）。在其提出五年之后，这一方法被 Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models（DDPM）[ [23](#bib.bib3) ]重新激活并推广：其中一项关键发现是让噪声成为预测目标（即 $\bm{\epsilon}$-预测）。

units.en: The relationships among different prediction targets were then investigated in [ [52](#bib.bib27) ] (originally in the context of model distillation), where the notion of $\bm{v}$ -prediction was also introduced. Their work focused on the weighting effects introduced by reparameterization.
units.zh: 随后，[ [52](#bib.bib27) ]（最初是在模型蒸馏的背景下）研究了不同预测目标之间的关系，并在其中引入了 $\bm{v}$-预测这一概念。他们的工作关注重参数化所带来的加权效应。

units.en: Meanwhile, EDM [ [29](#bib.bib30) ] reformulated the diffusion problem around a denoiser function , which constitutes a major milestone in the evolution of diffusion models. However, EDM adopted a pre-conditioned formulation, where the direct output of the network is not the denoised image. While this formulation is preferable in low-dimensional scenarios, it still inherently requires the network to output a quantity that mixes data and noise (more comparisons in appendix).
units.zh: 与此同时，EDM[ [29](#bib.bib30) ]围绕去噪器函数（denoiser）重新表述了扩散问题，这是扩散模型演化中的一个重要里程碑。然而，EDM 采用了预条件化的表述，网络的直接输出并不是去噪后的图像。这种表述在低维情形下更可取，但它本质上仍要求网络输出一个混合了数据与噪声的量（更多比较见附录）。

units.en: Flow Matching models [ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ] can be interpreted as a form of $\bm{v}$ -prediction [ [52](#bib.bib27) ] within the diffusion modeling framework. Unlike pure noise, $\bm{v}$ is a combination of data and noise. The connections between flow-based models and previous diffusion models have been established [ [15](#bib.bib31) ] . Today, diffusion models and their flow-based counterparts are often studied under a unified framework.
units.zh: Flow Matching 模型[ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ]可以解释为扩散建模范式内的一种 $\bm{v}$-预测[ [52](#bib.bib27) ]形式。与纯噪声不同，$\bm{v}$ 是数据与噪声的组合。基于流的模型与先前扩散模型之间的联系已经建立[ [15](#bib.bib31) ]。今天，扩散模型及其基于流的对应物常常在统一框架下被研究。

units.en: Denoising Models.
units.zh: 去噪模型。

units.en: Over the past decades, the concept of denoising has been closely related to representation learning. Classical methods, exemplified by BM3D [ [9](#bib.bib45) ] and others [ [47](#bib.bib46) , [14](#bib.bib47) , [79](#bib.bib48) ] , leveraged the assumptions of sparsity and low dimensionality to perform image denoising.
units.zh: 在过去几十年中，去噪这一概念与表征学习紧密相关。以 BM3D[ [9](#bib.bib45) ]及其他方法[ [47](#bib.bib46) , [14](#bib.bib47) , [79](#bib.bib48) ]为代表的经典方法，利用稀疏性与低维性假设来执行图像去噪。

units.en: Denoising Autoencoders (DAEs) [ [68](#bib.bib10) , [69](#bib.bib33) ] were developed as an unsupervised representation learning method, using denoising as their training objective. They leveraged the manifold assumption [ [4](#bib.bib32) ] ( [Fig. 1](#S1.F1) ) to learn meaningful representations that approximate the low-dimensional data manifold. DAEs can be viewed as a form of Denoising Score Matching [ [67](#bib.bib49) ] , which in turn is closely related to modern score-based diffusion models [ [59](#bib.bib5) , [60](#bib.bib6) ] . Nevertheless, while it is natural for DAEs to predict clean data for manifold learning, in score matching, predicting the score function effectively amounts to predicting the noise (up to a scaling factor), *i.e* . , $\bm{\epsilon}$ -prediction.
units.zh: 去噪自编码器（DAE）[ [68](#bib.bib10) , [69](#bib.bib33) ]是作为一种无监督表征学习方法发展起来的，以去噪作为其训练目标。它们借助流形假设[ [4](#bib.bib32) ]（[图 1](#S1.F1)）来学习有意义的、能近似低维数据流形的表征。DAE 可以被视为 Denoising Score Matching[ [67](#bib.bib49) ]的一种形式，而后者又与基于分数的现代扩散模型[ [59](#bib.bib5) , [60](#bib.bib6) ]密切相关。然而，尽管 DAE 为进行流形学习而预测干净数据是自然的，在 score matching 中，预测 score 函数实际上等同于预测噪声（相差一个缩放因子），即 $\bm{\epsilon}$-预测。

units.en: Manifold Learning.
units.zh: 流形学习。

units.en: Manifold learning has been a classical field [ [51](#bib.bib62) , [63](#bib.bib63) ] focused on learning low-dimensional, nonlinear representations from observed data. In general, manifold learning methods leverage bottleneck structures [ [64](#bib.bib58) , [48](#bib.bib59) , [41](#bib.bib60) , [2](#bib.bib61) ] that encourage only useful information to pass through. Several studies have explored the connections between manifold learning and generative models [ [39](#bib.bib43) , [27](#bib.bib64) , [8](#bib.bib18) ] . Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) [ [49](#bib.bib7) ] can be viewed as manifold learning in the first stage via an autoencoder, followed by diffusion in the second stage.
units.zh: 流形学习一直是一个经典领域[ [51](#bib.bib62) , [63](#bib.bib63) ]，专注于从观测数据中学习低维、非线性的表征。总体而言，流形学习方法利用瓶颈结构[ [64](#bib.bib58) , [48](#bib.bib59) , [41](#bib.bib60) , [2](#bib.bib61) ]，只鼓励有用的信息通过。若干研究探讨了流形学习与生成模型之间的联系[ [39](#bib.bib43) , [27](#bib.bib64) , [8](#bib.bib18) ]。Latent Diffusion Models（LDM）[ [49](#bib.bib7) ]可以被视为在第一阶段通过自编码器进行流形学习，在第二阶段再进行扩散。

units.en: Pixel-space Diffusion.
units.zh: 像素空间扩散。

units.en: While latent diffusion [ [49](#bib.bib7) ] has become the default choice in the field today, the development of diffusion models originally began with pixel-space formulations [ [59](#bib.bib5) , [23](#bib.bib3) , [44](#bib.bib53) , [12](#bib.bib25) ] . Early pixel-space diffusion models were typically based on dense convolutional networks, most often a U-Net [ [50](#bib.bib23) ] . These models often use over-complete channel representations ( *e.g* . , transforming $H{\times}W{\times}3$ into $H{\times}W{\times}128$ in the first layer), accompanied by long-range skip connections. While these models work well for $\epsilon$ - and $v$ -prediction, their dense convolutional structures are typically computationally expensive. Applying these convolutional models to high-resolution images does not lead to catastrophic degradation, and as such, research in this direction has commonly focused on noise schedules and/or weighting schemes [ [7](#bib.bib39) , [25](#bib.bib17) , [26](#bib.bib26) , [30](#bib.bib16) ] to further improve generation quality.
units.zh: 尽管潜变量扩散[ [49](#bib.bib7) ]在今天已成为该领域的默认选择，扩散模型的发展最初却始于像素空间的表述[ [59](#bib.bib5) , [23](#bib.bib3) , [44](#bib.bib53) , [12](#bib.bib25) ]。早期像素空间扩散模型通常基于密集卷积网络，最常见的是 U-Net[ [50](#bib.bib23) ]。这类模型常常使用过完备的通道表示（例如在第一层把 $H{\times}W{\times}3$ 变为 $H{\times}W{\times}128$），并配有长程跳跃连接。虽然这些模型对 $\epsilon$-预测与 $v$-预测效果良好，但其密集卷积结构通常计算开销很大。把这类卷积模型应用到高分辨率图像并不会导致灾难性退化，因此该方向的研究通常聚焦于噪声调度和/或加权方案[ [7](#bib.bib39) , [25](#bib.bib17) , [26](#bib.bib26) , [30](#bib.bib16) ]，以进一步提升生成质量。

units.en: In contrast, applying a Vision Transformer (ViT) [ [13](#bib.bib8) ] directly to pixels presents a more challenging task. Standard ViT architectures adopt an aggressive patch size ( *e.g* . , 16 $\times$ 16 pixels), resulting in a high-dimensional token space that can be comparable to, or larger than, the Transformer’s hidden dimension. SiD2 [ [26](#bib.bib26) ] and PixelFlow [ [6](#bib.bib38) ] adopt hierarchical designs that start from smaller patches; however, these models are “FLOP-heavy” [ [26](#bib.bib26) ] and lose the inherent generality and simplicity of standard Transformers. PixNerd [ [70](#bib.bib54) ] adopts a NeRF head [ [43](#bib.bib55) ] that integrates information from the Transformer output, noisy input, and spatial coordinates, with training further assisted by representation alignment [ [74](#bib.bib35) ] .
units.zh: 相比之下，把 Vision Transformer（ViT）[ [13](#bib.bib8) ]直接用于像素是一项更具挑战性的任务。标准 ViT 架构采用激进的图块尺寸（例如 16 $\times$ 16 像素），由此得到高维的 token 空间，其维度可与 Transformer 的隐藏维度相当甚至更大。SiD2[ [26](#bib.bib26) ]与 PixelFlow[ [6](#bib.bib38) ]采用从小图块开始的分层设计；然而，这些模型是“FLOP-heavy”的[ [26](#bib.bib26) ]，并且丧失了标准 Transformer 固有的通用性与简洁性。PixNerd[ [70](#bib.bib54) ]采用一个 NeRF 头[ [43](#bib.bib55) ]，整合来自 Transformer 输出、噪声输入与空间坐标的信息，训练时还借助表征对齐[ [74](#bib.bib35) ]来辅助。

units.en: Even with these special-purpose designs, the architectures in these works typically start from the “L” (Large) or “XL” size. In fact, a latest work [ [73](#bib.bib56) ] suggests that a large hidden size appears necessary for high dimensionality.
units.zh: 即便采用这些专用设计，这些工作中的架构通常也从“L”（Large）或“XL”规模起步。事实上，一项最新工作[ [73](#bib.bib56) ]表明，对于高维情形，较大的隐藏维度似乎是必要的。

units.en: High-dimensional Diffusion.
units.zh: 高维扩散。

units.en: When using ViT-style architectures, modern diffusion models are still challenged by high-dimensional input spaces, whether in pixels or latents. In the literature [ [8](#bib.bib18) , [73](#bib.bib56) , [55](#bib.bib68) ] , it has been repeatedly reported that ViT-style diffusion models degrade rapidly and catastrophically when the per-token dimensionality increases, regardless of the use of pixels or latents.
units.zh: 在使用 ViT 式架构时，现代扩散模型仍受高维输入空间的挑战，无论输入是像素还是潜变量。文献[ [8](#bib.bib18) , [73](#bib.bib56) , [55](#bib.bib68) ]中反复报告，无论使用像素还是潜变量，当每个 token 的维度增加时，ViT 式扩散模型都会迅速且灾难性地退化。

units.en: Concurrently with our work, a line of research [ [78](#bib.bib40) , [34](#bib.bib57) , [55](#bib.bib68) ] resorts to self-supervised pre-training to address high-dimensional diffusion. In contrast to these efforts, we show that high-dimensional diffusion is achievable without any pre-training, and using just Transformers.
units.zh: 与我们的工作同时，一系列研究[ [78](#bib.bib40) , [34](#bib.bib57) , [55](#bib.bib68) ]求助于自监督预训练来解决高维扩散问题。与这些努力不同，我们表明高维扩散无需任何预训练即可实现，而且只用 Transformer。

units.en: $\bm{x}$ -prediction.
units.zh: $\bm{x}$-预测。

units.en: The formulation of $\bm{x}$ -prediction is natural and not new; it can be traced back at least to the original DDPM [ [23](#bib.bib3) ] (see their code [ [24](#bib.bib73) ] ). However, DDPM observed that $\bm{\epsilon}$ -prediction was substantially better, which later became the go-to solution. In later works ( *e.g* . , [ [26](#bib.bib26) ] ), although the analysis was sometimes preferably conducted in the $\bm{x}$ -space, the actual prediction was often made in other spaces, likely for legacy reasons.
units.zh: $\bm{x}$-预测的表述是自然的，也并不新颖；它至少可以追溯到最初的 DDPM[ [23](#bib.bib3) ]（见其代码[ [24](#bib.bib73) ]）。然而，DDPM 观察到 $\bm{\epsilon}$-预测显著更好，这一点后来成为首选方案。在后续工作中（例如[ [26](#bib.bib26) ]），尽管分析有时更倾向于在 $\bm{x}$-空间中进行，实际的预测却常常在其他空间完成，很可能是出于历史遗留原因。

units.en: When it comes to the image restoration application addressed by diffusion [ [10](#bib.bib50) , [72](#bib.bib51) , [42](#bib.bib52) ] , it is natural for the network to predict the clean data, as this is the ultimate goal of image restoration. Concurrent with our work, [ [18](#bib.bib75) ] also advocates the use of $\bm{x}$ -prediction, for generative world models that are conditional on previous frames.
units.zh: 至于扩散所处理的图像复原应用[ [10](#bib.bib50) , [72](#bib.bib51) , [42](#bib.bib52) ]，让网络预测干净数据是自然的，因为这正是图像复原的最终目标。与我们的工作同时，[ [18](#bib.bib75) ]也主张使用 $\bm{x}$-预测，用于以先前帧为条件的生成式世界模型。

units.en: Our work does not aim to reinvent this fundamental concept; rather, we aim to draw attention to a largely overlooked yet critical issue in the context of high-dimensional data with underlying low-dimensional manifolds.
units.zh: 我们的工作并非要重新发明这一基本概念；相反，我们想提请注意一个在具有潜在低维流形的高维数据背景下被大量忽视、却十分关键的问题。

units.en: Table 1 : All possible combinations of defining the loss and network prediction in $\bm{x}$ , $\bm{v}$ , or $\bm{\epsilon}$ spaces. The direct network outputs are highlighted in colors. For any off-diagonal entry where the network output space differs from the loss space, a transformation on the network output is applied.
units.zh: 表 1：在 $\bm{x}$、$\bm{v}$ 或 $\bm{\epsilon}$ 空间中定义损失与网络预测的所有可能组合。网络直接输出的量用颜色标出。对于任何网络输出空间与损失空间不一致的非对角项，都会对网络输出施加一次变换。

units.en: 3 On Prediction Outputs of Diffusion Models
units.zh: 3 扩散模型的预测输出

units.en: Diffusion models can be formulated in the space of $\bm{x}$ , $\bm{\epsilon}$ , or $\bm{v}$ . The choice of the space determines not only where the loss is defined, but also what the network predicts. Importantly, the loss space and the network output space need not be the same . This choice can make critical differences.
units.zh: 扩散模型可以在 $\bm{x}$、$\bm{\epsilon}$ 或 $\bm{v}$ 空间中表述。空间的选择不仅决定了损失定义在哪里，也决定了网络预测什么。重要的是，**损失空间与网络输出空间不必相同**。这一选择可能带来关键差异。

units.en: 3.1 Background: Diffusion and Flows
units.zh: 3.1 背景：扩散与流

units.en: Diffusion models can be formulated from the perspective of ODEs [ [5](#bib.bib41) , [60](#bib.bib6) , [37](#bib.bib24) , [58](#bib.bib13) ] . We begin our formulation with the flow-based paradigm [ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ] , *i.e* . , in the $\bm{v}$ -space, as a simpler starting point, and then discuss other spaces.
units.zh: 扩散模型可以从 ODE 的角度来表述[ [5](#bib.bib41) , [60](#bib.bib6) , [37](#bib.bib24) , [58](#bib.bib13) ]。我们以基于流的范式[ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ]（即 $\bm{v}$ 空间）作为更简单的起点开始表述，然后再讨论其他空间。

units.en: Consider a data distribution $\bm{x}\sim p_{\text{data}}(\bm{x})$ and a noise distribution $\bm{\epsilon}\sim p_{\text{noise}}(\bm{\epsilon})$ ( *e.g* . , $\bm{\epsilon}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\mathbf{I})$ ). During training, a noisy sample $\bm{z}_{t}$ is an interpolation: $\bm{z}_{t}\,=\,a_{t}\,\bm{x}\,+\,b_{t}\,\bm{\epsilon}$ , where $a_{t}$ and $b_{t}$ are pre-defined noise schedules at time $t\in[0,1]$ . In this paper, we use a linear schedule [ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ] : $a_{t}=t$ and $b_{t}=1-t$ . This gives:
units.zh: 考虑数据分布 $\bm{x}\sim p_{\text{data}}(\bm{x})$ 与噪声分布 $\bm{\epsilon}\sim p_{\text{noise}}(\bm{\epsilon})$（例如 $\bm{\epsilon}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\mathbf{I})$）。训练时，一个加噪样本 $\bm{z}_{t}$ 是一次插值：$\bm{z}_{t}\,=\,a_{t}\,\bm{x}\,+\,b_{t}\,\bm{\epsilon}$，其中 $a_{t}$ 与 $b_{t}$ 是时间 $t\in[0,1]$ 上预定义的噪声调度。本文采用线性调度[ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ]：$a_{t}=t$ 且 $b_{t}=1-t$。由此得到：
这条式子定义时间轴：$t=0$ 时 $\bm{z}_0=\bm{\epsilon}$，是纯噪声；$t=1$ 时 $\bm{z}_1=\bm{x}$，是干净图像。中间是二者的线性插值。读论文时先确认这个方向，否则会把“高噪声端”和“干净端”弄反。
units.note: 这条式子定义时间轴：$t=0$ 时 $\bm{z}_0=\bm{\epsilon}$，是纯噪声；$t=1$ 时 $\bm{z}_1=\bm{x}$，是干净图像。中间是二者的线性插值。读论文时先确认这个方向，否则会把“高噪声端”和“干净端”弄反。

units.en: which leads to $\bm{z}_{t}\sim p_{\text{data}}$ when $t{=}1$ . We use the logit-normal distribution over $t$ [ [15](#bib.bib31) ] , *i.e* . , $\text{logit}(t)\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^{2})$ .
units.zh: 这使得当 $t{=}1$ 时 $\bm{z}_{t}\sim p_{\text{data}}$。我们对 $t$ 使用 logit-normal 分布[ [15](#bib.bib31) ]，即 $\text{logit}(t)\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^{2})$。

units.en: A flow velocity $\bm{v}$ is defined as the time-derivative of $\bm{z}$ , that is, $\bm{v}_{t}=\bm{z}_{t}^{\prime}=a^{\prime}_{t}\bm{x}+b^{\prime}_{t}\bm{\epsilon}$ . Given [Eq. 1](#S3.E1) , we have:
units.zh: 流速度 $\bm{v}$ 定义为 $\bm{z}$ 的时间导数，即 $\bm{v}_{t}=\bm{z}_{t}^{\prime}=a^{\prime}_{t}\bm{x}+b^{\prime}_{t}\bm{\epsilon}$。给定[式 1](#S3.E1)，我们有：

units.en: $\bm{v}=\bm{x}-\bm{\epsilon}.$ (2)
units.zh: 速度 $\bm{v}$ 是沿这条直线从噪声指向干净图像的向量。因为 $\bm{z}_t$ 对 $t$ 的导数是 $\bm{x}-\bm{\epsilon}$，所以速度在整个路径上是常量，不随 $t$ 改变。
units.note: 速度 $\bm{v}$ 是沿这条直线从噪声指向干净图像的向量。因为 $\bm{z}_t$ 对 $t$ 的导数是 $\bm{x}-\bm{\epsilon}$，所以速度在整个路径上是常量，不随 $t$ 改变。

units.en: The flow-based methods [ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ] minimize a loss function defined as:
units.zh: 基于流的方法[ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ]最小化如下定义的损失函数：

units.en: $\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}_{t,\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon}}\|\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{v}\|^{2},$ (3)
units.zh: 训练目标是让网络预测的速度接近真实速度 $\bm{v}$。这是 flow matching 的标准 L2 损失；损失定义在 $\bm{v}$ 空间，而网络直接输出可以是 $\bm{x}$、$\bm{\epsilon}$ 或 $\bm{v}$（表 1）。
units.note: 训练目标是让网络预测的速度接近真实速度 $\bm{v}$。这是 flow matching 的标准 L2 损失；损失定义在 $\bm{v}$ 空间，而网络直接输出可以是 $\bm{x}$、$\bm{\epsilon}$ 或 $\bm{v}$（表 1）。

units.en: where $\bm{v}_{\theta}$ is a function parameterized by $\theta$ . While $\bm{v}_{\theta}$ is often the direct output of a network $\bm{v}_{\theta}\,=\,\text{{net}}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)$ [ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ] , it can also be a transform of it, as we will elaborate.
units.zh: 其中 $\bm{v}_{\theta}$ 是由 $\theta$ 参数化的函数。虽然 $\bm{v}_{\theta}$ 常常就是网络的直接输出 $\bm{v}_{\theta}\,=\,\text{{net}}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)$[ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ]，它也可以是该输出的一个变换，我们将在下文详述。

units.en: Given the function $\bm{v}_{\theta}$ , sampling is done by solving an ordinary differential equation (ODE) for $\bm{z}$ [ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ] :
units.zh: 给定函数 $\bm{v}_{\theta}$，采样通过求解关于 $\bm{z}$ 的常微分方程（ODE）来完成[ [37](#bib.bib24) , [38](#bib.bib29) , [1](#bib.bib28) ]：
采样时解这个常微分方程：从 $t=0$ 的噪声出发，沿网络给出的速度场积分到 $t=1$。Euler 是一阶近似（算法 2），实验默认用二阶的 Heun。
units.note: 采样时解这个常微分方程：从 $t=0$ 的噪声出发，沿网络给出的速度场积分到 $t=1$。Euler 是一阶近似（算法 2），实验默认用二阶的 Heun。

units.en: starting from $\bm{z}_{0}\sim p_{\text{noise}}$ and ending at $t=1$ . In practice, this ODE can be approximately solved using numerical solvers. By default, we use a 50-step Heun.
units.zh: 从 $\bm{z}_{0}\sim p_{\text{noise}}$ 出发，结束于 $t=1$。实践中，该 ODE 可以用数值求解器近似求解。默认情况下，我们使用 50 步的 Heun。

units.en: 3.2 Prediction Space and Loss Space
units.zh: 3.2 预测空间与损失空间

units.en: Prediction Space.
units.zh: 预测空间。

units.en: The network’s direct output can be defined in any space: $\bm{v}$ , $\bm{x}$ , or $\bm{\epsilon}$ . Next, we discuss the resulting transformation. Note that in the context of this paper, we refer to it as “ $\bm{x}$ , $\bm{\epsilon}$ , $\bm{v}$ - prediction ”, only when the network $\text{{net}}_{\theta}$ ’s direct output is strictly $\bm{x}$ , $\bm{\epsilon}$ , $\bm{v}$ , respectively.
units.zh: 网络的直接输出可以定义在任意空间中：$\bm{v}$、$\bm{x}$ 或 $\bm{\epsilon}$。下面讨论由此产生的变换。注意，在本文语境下，只有当网络 $\text{{net}}_{\theta}$ 的直接输出严格为 $\bm{x}$、$\bm{\epsilon}$、$\bm{v}$ 时，我们才分别称其为“$\bm{x}$、$\bm{\epsilon}$、$\bm{v}$-预测”。

units.en: Given three unknowns ( $\bm{x}$ , $\bm{\epsilon}$ , $\bm{v}$ ) and one network output, we require two additional constraints to determine all three unknowns. The two constraints are given by [Eq. 1](#S3.E1) and ( [2](#S3.E2) ). For example , when we let the direct network output $\text{{net}}_{\theta}$ be $\bm{x}$ , we solve the following set of equations:
units.zh: 给定三个未知量（$\bm{x}$、$\bm{\epsilon}$、$\bm{v}$）与一个网络输出，我们需要两个额外的约束才能确定全部三个未知量。这两个约束由[式 1](#S3.E1)与[式 2](#S3.E2)给出。例如，当我们令网络的直接输出 $\text{{net}}_{\theta}$ 为 $\bm{x}$ 时，我们求解如下方程组：

units.en: $\left\{\begin{aligned} \bm{x}_{\theta}&=\text{{net}}_{\theta}\\ \bm{z}_{t}&=t\,\bm{x}_{\theta}+(1-t)\,\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}\\ \bm{v}_{\theta}&=\bm{x}_{\theta}-\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}\end{aligned}\right.$ (5)
units.zh: 当网络直接输出 $\bm{x}_\theta$ 时，另外两个量由代数关系确定：$\bm{\epsilon}_\theta=(\bm{z}_t-t\bm{x}_\theta)/(1-t)$，$\bm{v}_\theta=\bm{x}_\theta-\bm{\epsilon}_\theta$。$t\to1$ 时分母接近零，实现要截断（默认 0.05）。
units.note: 当网络直接输出 $\bm{x}_\theta$ 时，另外两个量由代数关系确定：$\bm{\epsilon}_\theta=(\bm{z}_t-t\bm{x}_\theta)/(1-t)$，$\bm{v}_\theta=\bm{x}_\theta-\bm{\epsilon}_\theta$。$t\to1$ 时分母接近零，实现要截断（默认 0.05）。

units.en: Here, the notations $\bm{x}_{\theta}$ , $\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}$ , and $\bm{v}_{\theta}$ suggest that they are all predictions dependent on $\theta$ . Solving this equation set gives: $\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}=(\bm{z}_{t}-t\bm{x}_{\theta})/(1-t)$ and $\bm{v}_{\theta}=(\bm{x}_{\theta}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)$ , that is, both $\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}$ and $\bm{v}_{\theta}$ can be computed from $\bm{z}_{t}$ and the network $\bm{x}_{\theta}$ . These are summarized in [Tab. 1](#S2.T1) in column (a) .
units.zh: 这里，记号 $\bm{x}_{\theta}$、$\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}$、$\bm{v}_{\theta}$ 表明它们都是依赖于 $\theta$ 的预测。解这个方程组得到：$\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}=(\bm{z}_{t}-t\bm{x}_{\theta})/(1-t)$ 与 $\bm{v}_{\theta}=(\bm{x}_{\theta}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)$，也就是说，$\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}$ 与 $\bm{v}_{\theta}$ 都可以由 $\bm{z}_{t}$ 与网络输出 $\bm{x}_{\theta}$ 算出。这些结果汇总在[表 1](#S2.T1)的 (a) 列中。

units.en: Similarly, when we let the direct network output $\text{{net}}_{\theta}$ be $\bm{\epsilon}$ or $\bm{v}$ , we obtain the other sets of equations (by replacing the first one in [Eq. 5](#S3.E5) ). The transformations are summarized in [Tab. 1](#S2.T1) in the columns of (b) , (c) for $\bm{\epsilon}$ -, $\bm{v}$ -prediction. This shows that when one quantity in $\{\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon},\bm{v}\}$ is predicted, the other two can be inferred. The derivations in many prior works ( *e.g* . , [ [52](#bib.bib27) , [15](#bib.bib31) ] ) are special cases covered in [Tab. 1](#S2.T1) .
units.zh: 类似地，当我们令网络的直接输出 $\text{{net}}_{\theta}$ 为 $\bm{\epsilon}$ 或 $\bm{v}$ 时，我们得到另两组方程（替换[式 5](#S3.E5)中的第一式）。这些变换汇总在[表 1](#S2.T1)的 (b)、(c) 两列中，分别对应 $\bm{\epsilon}$-预测与 $\bm{v}$-预测。这表明，当预测 $\{\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon},\bm{v}\}$ 中的一个量时，另外两个可以被推断出来。许多先前工作（例如[ [52](#bib.bib27) , [15](#bib.bib31) ]）中的推导都是[表 1](#S2.T1)所涵盖的特例。

units.en: Loss Space.
units.zh: 损失空间。

units.en: While the loss is often defined in one reference space ( *e.g* . , $\bm{v}$ -loss in [Eq. 3](#S3.E3) ), conceptually, one can define it in any space. It has been shown [ [52](#bib.bib27) , [15](#bib.bib31) ] that with a given reparameterization from one prediction space to another, the loss is effectively reweighted.
units.zh: 虽然损失常常在某一个参考空间中定义（例如[式 3](#S3.E3)中的 $\bm{v}$-损失），但从概念上讲，它可以定义在任意空间。已有研究表明[ [52](#bib.bib27) , [15](#bib.bib31) ]，在从一个预测空间到另一个的重参数化下，损失实际上被重新加权。

units.en: For example , consider the combination of $\bm{x}$ -prediction and $\bm{v}$ -loss in [Tab. 1](#S2.T1) (3)(a) . We have $\bm{v}_{\theta}=(\bm{x}_{\theta}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)$ as the prediction and $\bm{v}=(\bm{x}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)$ as the target. The $\bm{v}$ -loss in [Eq. 3](#S3.E3) becomes: $\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}\|\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{v}\|^{2}=\mathbb{E}\frac{1}{(1-t)^{2}}\|\bm{x}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{x}\|^{2},$ which is a reweighted form of the $\bm{x}$ -loss. A transformation like this one can be done for any prediction space and any loss space listed in [Tab. 1](#S2.T1) .
units.zh: 例如，考虑[表 1](#S2.T1)(3)(a) 中 $\bm{x}$-预测与 $\bm{v}$-损失的组合。我们以 $\bm{v}_{\theta}=(\bm{x}_{\theta}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)$ 作为预测，以 $\bm{v}=(\bm{x}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)$ 作为目标。[式 3](#S3.E3)中的 $\bm{v}$-损失变为：$\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}\|\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{v}\|^{2}=\mathbb{E}\frac{1}{(1-t)^{2}}\|\bm{x}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{x}\|^{2},$ 这是 $\bm{x}$-损失的一种重新加权形式。对[表 1](#S2.T1)中列出的任意预测空间与任意损失空间，都可以做类似的变换。

units.en: Put together, consider the three unweighted losses defined in $\{\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon},\bm{v}\}$ , and the three forms of the network direct output, there are nine possible combinations ( [Tab. 1](#S2.T1) ). Each combination constitutes a valid formulation, and no two among the nine cases are mathematically equivalent.
units.zh: 综合起来，考虑在 $\{\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon},\bm{v}\}$ 中定义的三种未加权损失，以及网络直接输出的三种形式，共有九种可能的组合（[表 1](#S2.T1)）。每种组合都构成一个有效的表述，而九种情形中没有任何两种在数学上等价。

units.en: Generator Space.
units.zh: 生成器空间。

units.en: Regardless of the combination used, to perform generation at inference-time, we can always transform the network output to the $\bm{v}$ -space ( [Tab. 1](#S2.T1) , row (3)) and solve the ODE in [Eq. 4](#S3.E4) for sampling. As such, all nine combinations are legitimate generators.
units.zh: 无论使用哪种组合，为了在推理时进行生成，我们总可以把网络输出变换到 $\bm{v}$ 空间（[表 1](#S2.T1)第 (3) 行），并求解[式 4](#S3.E4)中的 ODE 来完成采样。因此，九种组合都是合法的生成器。

units.en: Figure 2 : Toy Experiment : $d$ -dimensional ( $d=2$ ) underlying data is “buried” in a $D$ -dimensional space, by a fixed, random, column-orthogonal projection matrix. In the $D$ -dim space, we train a simple generative model (5-layer ReLU MLP with 256-dim hidden units). The projection matrix is unknown to the model, and we only use it for visualizing the output. In this toy experiment, with the observed dimension $D$ increasing, only $\bm{x}$ -prediction can produce reasonable results.
units.zh: 图 2：玩具实验：$d$ 维（$d=2$）的底层数据通过一个固定的、随机的列正交投影矩阵「埋」到 $D$ 维空间中。在 $D$ 维空间里，我们训练一个简单的生成模型（5 层 ReLU MLP，隐藏单元 256 维）。模型不知道这个投影矩阵，我们只用它来可视化输出。在这个玩具实验中，随着观测维度 $D$ 增大，只有 $\bm{x}$-预测能产生合理结果。

units.en: 3.3 Toy Experiment
units.zh: 3.3 玩具实验

units.en: According to the manifold assumption [ [4](#bib.bib32) ] , the data $\bm{x}$ tends to lie in a low-dimensional manifold ( [Fig. 1](#S1.F1) ), while noise $\bm{\epsilon}$ and velocity $\bm{v}$ are off-manifold. Letting a network directly predict the clean data $\bm{x}$ should be more tractable. We verify this assumption in a toy experiment in this section.
units.zh: 依据流形假设[ [4](#bib.bib32) ]，数据 $\bm{x}$ 倾向于位于一个低维流形上（[图 1](#S1.F1)），而噪声 $\bm{\epsilon}$ 与速度 $\bm{v}$ 位于流形之外。让网络直接预测干净数据 $\bm{x}$ 应当更容易处理。本节用一个玩具实验验证这一假设。

units.en: We consider the toy case of $d$ -dimensional underlying data “buried” in an observed $D$ -dimensional space ( $d<D$ ). We synthesize this scenario using a projection matrix $P\in\mathbb{R}^{D\times d}$ that is column-orthogonal, *i.e* . , $P^{\top}P=I_{d\times d}$ . This matrix $P$ is randomly created and fixed. The observed data is $\bm{x}=P\hat{\bm{x}}\in\mathbb{R}^{D}$ , where the underlying data is $\hat{\bm{x}}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}$ . The matrix $P$ is unknown to the model, and as such, it is a $D$ -dimensional generation problem for the model.
units.zh: 我们考虑如下玩具情形：$d$ 维的潜在数据“埋”在观测到的 $D$ 维空间中（$d<D$）。我们用列正交的投影矩阵 $P\in\mathbb{R}^{D\times d}$（即 $P^{\top}P=I_{d\times d}$）合成这一情形。矩阵 $P$ 随机生成并固定。观测数据为 $\bm{x}=P\hat{\bm{x}}\in\mathbb{R}^{D}$，其中潜在数据为 $\hat{\bm{x}}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}$。模型并不知道矩阵 $P$，因此对模型而言这是一个 $D$ 维的生成问题。

units.en: We train a 5-layer ReLU MLP with 256-dim hidden units as the generator and visualize the results in [Fig. 2](#S3.F2) . We obtain these visualizations by projecting the $D$ -dim generated samples back to $d$ -dim using $P$ . We investigate the cases of $D\in\{2,8,16,512\}$ for $d=2$ . We study $\bm{x}$ , $\bm{\epsilon}$ , or $\bm{v}$ -prediction, all using the $\bm{v}$ -loss, *i.e* . , [Tab. 1](#S2.T1) (3)(a-c) .
units.zh: 我们训练一个隐藏单元为 256 维的 5 层 ReLU MLP 作为生成器，结果可视化在[图 2](#S3.F2)中。可视化的做法是用 $P$ 把 $D$ 维的生成样本投影回 $d$ 维。我们考察 $d=2$ 时 $D\in\{2,8,16,512\}$ 的情形。我们研究 $\bm{x}$-、$\bm{\epsilon}$-、$\bm{v}$-预测，三者都使用 $\bm{v}$-损失，即[表 1](#S2.T1)的 (3)(a-c)。

units.en: [Fig. 2](#S3.F2) shows that only $\bm{x}$ -prediction can produce reasonable results when $D$ increases . For $\bm{\epsilon}$ -/ $\bm{v}$ -prediction, the models struggle at $D{=}16$ , and fail catastrophically when $D{=}512$ , where the 256-dim MLP is under-complete.
units.zh: [图 2](#S3.F2)显示，当 $D$ 增大时，只有 $\bm{x}$-预测能产生合理的结果。对于 $\bm{\epsilon}$-/$\bm{v}$-预测，模型在 $D{=}16$ 时已经吃力，在 $D{=}512$ 时灾难性失败——此时 256 维的 MLP 是不完备的（under-complete）。

units.en: Notably, $\bm{x}$ -prediction can work well even when the model is under-complete . Here, the 256-dim MLP inevitably discards information in the $D{=}512$ -dim space. However, since the true data is in a low-dimensional $d$ -dim space, $\bm{x}$ -prediction can still perform well, as the ideal output is implicitly $d$ -dim. We draw similar observations in the case of real data on ImageNet, as we show next.
units.zh: 值得注意的是，即使模型不完备，$\bm{x}$-预测也能良好工作。这里，256 维的 MLP 在 $D{=}512$ 维空间中不可避免地丢弃信息。然而，由于真实数据位于低维的 $d$ 维空间中，$\bm{x}$-预测仍能表现良好，因为理想输出隐含地只是 $d$ 维的。我们在 ImageNet 真实数据上也得到类似的观察，如下文所示。

units.en: 4 “Just Image Transformers” for Diffusion
units.zh: 4 用于扩散的“Just Image Transformers”

units.en: Driven by the above analysis, we show that plain Vision Transformers (ViT) [ [13](#bib.bib8) ] operating on pixels can work surprisingly well, simply using $\bm{x}$ -prediction.
units.zh: 在上述分析的驱动下，我们表明，直接在像素上运行的普通视觉 Transformer（ViT）[13](#bib.bib8) 可以工作得惊人地好，且只需使用 $\bm{x}$ 预测。

units.en: 4.1 Just Image Transformers
units.zh: 4.1 就是图像 Transformer

units.en: The core idea of ViT [ [13](#bib.bib8) ] is “ Transformer on Patches (ToP)’’ . Our architecture design follows this philosophy.
units.zh: ViT [13](#bib.bib8) 的核心思想是“Transformer on Patches（ToP，作用在 patch 上的 Transformer）”。我们的架构设计遵循这一理念。

units.en: Formally, consider $H{\times}W{\times}C$ -dim image data ( $C{=}3$ ). All $\bm{x}$ , $\bm{\epsilon}$ , $\bm{v}$ and $\bm{z}_{t}$ share this same dimensionality. Given an image, we divide it into non-overlapping patches of size $p{\times}p$ , resulting in a sequence of a length $\frac{H}{p}{\times}\frac{W}{p}$ . Each patch is a $p{\times}p{\times}3$ -dim vector. This sequence is processed by a linear embedding projection, added with positional embedding [ [66](#bib.bib22) ] , and mapped by a stack of Transformer blocks [ [66](#bib.bib22) ] . The output layer is a linear predictor that projects each token back to a $p{\times}p{\times}3$ -dim patch. See [Fig. 3](#S4.F3) .
units.zh: 形式上，考虑 $H{\times}W{\times}C$ 维的图像数据（$C{=}3$）。所有 $\bm{x}$、$\bm{\epsilon}$、$\bm{v}$ 和 $\bm{z}_{t}$ 都具有相同的维度。给定一幅图像，我们将其划分为大小为 $p{\times}p$ 的不重叠 patch，得到一个长度为 $\frac{H}{p}{\times}\frac{W}{p}$ 的序列。每个 patch 是一个 $p{\times}p{\times}3$ 维向量。该序列经线性嵌入投影处理，加上位置嵌入 [66](#bib.bib22)，再由一叠 Transformer 块 [66](#bib.bib22) 映射。输出层是一个线性预测器，把每个 token 投影回 $p{\times}p{\times}3$ 维的 patch。见[图3](#S4.F3)。

units.en: As standard practice, the architecture is conditioned on time $t$ and a given class label. We use adaLN-Zero [ [46](#bib.bib12) ] for conditioning and will discuss other options later. Conceptually, this architecture amounts to the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) [ [46](#bib.bib12) ] directly applied to patches of pixels.
units.zh: 按照标准做法，该架构以时间 $t$ 和给定类别标签为条件。我们使用 adaLN-Zero [46](#bib.bib12) 进行条件化，稍后还会讨论其他选项。在概念上，这一架构相当于把扩散 Transformer（DiT）[46](#bib.bib12) 直接作用于像素 patch。

units.en: The overall architecture is nothing more than “Just image Transformers”, which we refer to as JiT . For example, we investigate JiT/16 ( *i.e* . , patch size $p{=}16$ , [ [13](#bib.bib8) ] ) on $256{\times}256$ images, and JiT/32 ( $p{=}32$ ) on $512{\times}512$ images. These settings respectively result in a dimensionality of 768 ( $16{\times}16{\times}3$ ) and 3072 ( $32{\times}32{\times}3$ ) per patch. Such high-dimensional patches can be handled by $\bm{x}$ -prediction.
units.zh: 整体架构不过是“Just image Transformers”（就是图像 Transformer），我们称之为 JiT。例如，我们在 $256{\times}256$ 图像上研究 JiT/16（即 patch 大小 $p{=}16$，[13](#bib.bib8)），在 $512{\times}512$ 图像上研究 JiT/32（$p{=}32$）。这两种设置下每个 patch 的维度分别为 768（$16{\times}16{\times}3$）和 3072（$32{\times}32{\times}3$）。如此高维的 patch 可以由 $\bm{x}$ 预测来处理。

units.en: Figure 3 : The “Just image Transformer” (JiT) architecture : simply a plain ViT [ [13](#bib.bib8) ] on patches of pixels for $\bm{x}$ -prediction.
units.zh: 图 3：「Just image Transformer」（JiT）架构：不过是一个作用于像素图块、做 $\bm{x}$-预测的普通 ViT [13](#bib.bib8)。

units.en: 4.2 What to Predict by the Network?
units.zh: 4.2 网络应当预测什么？

units.en: We have summarized the nine possible combinations of loss space and prediction space in [Tab. 1](#S2.T1) . For each of these combinations, we train a “Base” [ [13](#bib.bib8) ] model (JiT-B), which has a hidden size of 768-dim per token. We study JiT-B/16 at 256 $\times$ 256 resolution in [Tab. 2](#S4.T2) (a). As a reference, we examine JiT-B/4 ( *i.e* . , $p{=}4$ ) at 64 $\times$ 64 in [Tab. 2](#S4.T2) (b). In both settings, the sequence length is the same (16 ${\times}$ 16).
units.zh: 我们在[表1](#S2.T1)中汇总了损失空间与预测空间的九种可能组合。对其中每种组合，我们训练一个“Base” [13](#bib.bib8) 模型（JiT-B），其每个 token 的隐藏维度为 768。我们在[表2](#S4.T2)(a) 中研究 $256{\times}256$ 分辨率下的 JiT-B/16。作为参照，我们在[表2](#S4.T2)(b) 中考察 $64{\times}64$ 下的 JiT-B/4（即 $p{=}4$）。两种设置下的序列长度相同（16${\times}$16）。

units.en: We draw the following observations:
units.zh: 我们得出以下观察：

units.en: $\bm{x}$ -prediction is critical.
units.zh: $\bm{x}$ 预测至关重要。

units.en: In [Tab. 2](#S4.T2) (a) with JiT-B/16, only $\bm{x}$ -prediction performs well , and it works across all three losses. Here, a patch is 768-d ( $16{\times}16{\times}3$ ), which coincides with the hidden size of 768 in JiT-B . While this may seem “about enough”, in practice the models may require additional capacity, *e.g* . , to handle positional embeddings. For $\bm{\epsilon}$ -/ $\bm{v}$ -prediction, the model does not have enough capacity to separate and retain the noised quantities. These observations are similar to those in the toy case ( [Fig. 2](#S3.F2) ).
units.zh: 在[表2](#S4.T2)(a) 的 JiT-B/16 中，只有 $\bm{x}$ 预测表现良好，并且它在三种损失下都有效。这里每个 patch 是 768 维（$16{\times}16{\times}3$），恰好与 JiT-B 的 768 维隐藏维度相同。这看似“差不多够用”，但实践中模型可能需要额外的容量，例如用于处理位置嵌入。对于 $\bm{\epsilon}$/$\bm{v}$ 预测，模型没有足够的容量来分离并保留加噪后的量。这些观察与玩具实验（[图2](#S3.F2)）中的情况类似。

units.en: As a comparison, we examine JiT-B/4 at 64 $\times$ 64 resolution ( [Tab. 2](#S4.T2) (b)). Here, all cases perform reasonably well: the accuracy gaps among the nine combinations are marginal, not decisive. The dimensionality is 48 ( $4{\times}4{\times}3$ ) per patch, well below the hidden size of 768 in JiT-B , which explains why all combinations work reasonably well. We note that many previous latent diffusion models have a similarly small input dimensionality and therefore were not exposed to the issue we discuss here.
units.zh: 作为对照，我们考察 $64{\times}64$ 分辨率下的 JiT-B/4（[表2](#S4.T2)(b)）。此时所有情形都表现尚可：九种组合之间的准确度差距是边缘性的，不具决定性。每个 patch 的维度为 48（$4{\times}4{\times}3$），远低于 JiT-B 的 768 维隐藏维度，这解释了为何所有组合都能正常工作。我们注意到，许多先前的潜空间扩散模型具有同样小的输入维度，因此没有暴露于我们此处讨论的问题。

units.en: Table 2 : Results of all combinations of loss space and network space (see [Tab. 1](#S2.T1) ), evaluated by FID-50K on ImageNet: (a) JiT-B/16 at 256 resolution, 768-d per patch; (b) JiT-B/4 at 64 resolution, 48-d per patch. We annotate catastrophic failures in red and reasonable results by green. Settings: 200 epochs, with CFG [ [22](#bib.bib14) ] .
units.zh: 表 2：损失空间与网络空间所有组合的结果（见表 1），在 ImageNet 上用 FID-50K 评估：(a) JiT-B/16、256 分辨率、每图块 768 维；(b) JiT-B/4、64 分辨率、每图块 48 维。我们把灾难性失败标为红色，把合理结果标为绿色。设置：200 轮，使用 CFG [22](#bib.bib14)。

units.en: Loss weighting is not sufficient.
units.zh: 损失加权并不足够。

units.en: Our work is not the first to enumerate the combinations of relevant factors. In [ [52](#bib.bib27) ] , it has explored the combinations of loss weighting and network predictions. Their experiments were done on the low-dimensional CIFAR-10 dataset, using a U-net. Their observations were closer to ours on ImageNet 64 $\times$ 64.
units.zh: 我们的工作并非首次枚举相关因素的组合。文献 [52](#bib.bib27) 探索了损失加权与网络预测的组合。他们的实验在低维的 CIFAR-10 数据集上使用 U-net 完成。他们的观察更接近我们在 ImageNet $64{\times}64$ 上的结果。

units.en: However, [Tab. 2](#S4.T2) (a) on ImageNet 256 $\times$ 256 suggests that loss weighting is not the whole story . On one hand, both $\bm{\epsilon}$ - and $\bm{v}$ -prediction fail catastrophically in [Tab. 2](#S4.T2) (a), regardless of the loss space, which corresponds to different effective weightings in different loss spaces (as discussed). On the other hand, $\bm{x}$ -prediction works across all three loss spaces: the loss weighting induced by the $\bm{v}$ -loss is preferable, but not critical.
units.zh: 然而，ImageNet $256{\times}256$ 上的[表2](#S4.T2)(a) 表明，损失加权并不是全部。一方面，无论损失空间如何，$\bm{\epsilon}$ 预测与 $\bm{v}$ 预测在[表2](#S4.T2)(a) 中都灾难性地失败，而不同损失空间对应着不同的有效加权（如前所述）。另一方面，$\bm{x}$ 预测在全部三种损失空间下都有效：$\bm{v}$ 损失所诱导的损失加权更可取，但并不关键。

units.en: Noise-level shift is not sufficient.
units.zh: 噪声水平平移并不足够。

units.en: Prior works [ [7](#bib.bib39) , [25](#bib.bib17) , [26](#bib.bib26) ] have suggested that increasing the noise level is useful for high-resolution pixel-based diffusion. We examine this in [Tab. 3](#S4.T3) with JiT-B/16. As we use the logit-normal distribution [ [15](#bib.bib31) ] for sampling $t$ (see appendix), the noise level can be shifted by changing the parameter $\mu$ of this distribution: intuitively, shifting $\mu$ towards the negative side results in smaller $t$ and thus increases the noise level ( [Eq. 1](#S3.E1) ).
units.zh: 先前工作 [7](#bib.bib39)、[25](#bib.bib17)、[26](#bib.bib26) 提出，提高噪声水平对高分辨率像素扩散有益。我们用 JiT-B/16 在[表3](#S4.T3)中考察这一点。由于我们使用 logit 正态分布 [15](#bib.bib31) 采样 $t$（见附录），可以通过改变该分布的参数 $\mu$ 来平移噪声水平：直观上，把 $\mu$ 向负方向移动会得到更小的 $t$，从而提高噪声水平（[式1](#S3.E1)）。

units.en: [Tab. 3](#S4.T3) shows that when the model already performs decently (here, $\bm{x}$ -pred ), appropriately high noise is beneficial, which is consistent with prior observations [ [7](#bib.bib39) , [25](#bib.bib17) , [26](#bib.bib26) ] . However, adjusting the noise level alone cannot remedy $\bm{\epsilon}$ - or $\bm{v}$ -prediction: their failure stems inherently from the inability to propagate high-dimensional information.
units.zh: [表3](#S4.T3)显示，当模型本已表现尚可（此处为 $\bm{x}$ 预测）时，适当高的噪声是有益的，这与先前的观察 [7](#bib.bib39)、[25](#bib.bib17)、[26](#bib.bib26) 一致。然而，仅调整噪声水平无法挽救 $\bm{\epsilon}$ 或 $\bm{v}$ 预测：它们的失败本质上源于无法传递高维信息。

units.en: As a side note, according to [Tab. 3](#S4.T3) , we set $\mu$ = –0.8 in other experiments on ImageNet 256 $\times$ 256.
units.zh: 附带说明，根据[表3](#S4.T3)，我们在 ImageNet $256{\times}256$ 的其他实验中设置 $\mu$ = –0.8。

units.en: Increasing hidden units is not necessary.
units.zh: 增加隐藏单元并非必要。

units.en: Since the capacity can be limited by the network width ( *i.e* . , numbers of hidden units), a natural idea is to increase it. However, this remedy is neither principled nor feasible when the observed dimension is very high. We show that this is not necessary in the case of $\bm{x}$ -prediction.
units.zh: 由于容量可能受网络宽度（即隐藏单元数量）限制，一个自然的想法是增加宽度。然而，当观测维度非常高时，这种补救既缺乏原理依据，也不可行。我们表明，在 $\bm{x}$ 预测的情形下这并无必要。

units.en: In [Tab. 5](#S5.T5) and [Tab. 6](#S5.T6) in the next section, we show results of JiT/32 at resolution 512 and JiT/64 at resolution 1024, using a proportionally large patch size of $p{=}32$ or $p{=}64$ . This amounts to 3072-dim ( *i.e* . , $32{\times}32{\times}3$ ) or 12288-dim per patch, substantially larger than the hidden size of B, L, and H models (defined in [ [13](#bib.bib8) ] ). Nevertheless, $\bm{x}$ -prediction works well; in fact, it works without any modification other than scaling the noise proportionally ( *e.g* . , by 2 $\times$ and 4 $\times$ at resolution 512 and 1024; see appendix).
units.zh: 在下一节的[表5](#S5.T5)和[表6](#S5.T6)中，我们给出分辨率 512 下 JiT/32 与分辨率 1024 下 JiT/64 的结果，使用按比例放大的 patch 大小 $p{=}32$ 或 $p{=}64$。这相当于每个 patch 3072 维（即 $32{\times}32{\times}3$）或 12288 维，远大于 B、L、H 模型的隐藏维度（定义见 [13](#bib.bib8)）。尽管如此，$\bm{x}$ 预测依然工作良好；事实上，除了按比例缩放噪声（例如在分辨率 512 和 1024 下分别放大 2 倍和 4 倍；见附录）之外，它无需任何修改。

units.en: This evidence suggests that the network design can be largely decoupled from the observed dimensionality, as is the case in many other neural network applications. Increasing the number of hidden units can be beneficial (as widely observed in deep learning), but it is not decisive.
units.zh: 这一证据表明，网络设计可以在很大程度上与观测维度解耦，正如许多其他神经网络应用中的情形。增加隐藏单元数量可能有益（这在深度学习中已被广泛观察到），但它不是决定性的。

units.en: Table 3 : Noise-level shift (JiT-B/16, ImageNet 256 $\times$ 256, FID-50K). We shift the noise level by adjusting $\mu$ in the logit-normal $t$ -sampler [ [15](#bib.bib31) ] . An appropriate noise level is useful, but is not sufficient for addressing the catastrophic failure in $\bm{\epsilon}$ -/ $\bm{v}$ -prediction. Settings (the same as [Tab. 2](#S4.T2) ): 200 epochs, with CFG.
units.zh: 表 3：噪声水平平移（JiT-B/16，ImageNet 256×256，FID-50K）。我们通过调整 logit-normal $t$ 采样器 [15](#bib.bib31) 中的 $\mu$ 来平移噪声水平。合适的噪声水平有用，但不足以解决 $\bm{\epsilon}$-/$\bm{v}$-预测的灾难性失败。设置（与表 2 相同）：200 轮，使用 CFG。

units.en: Figure 4 : Bottleneck linear embedding. Results are for JiT-B/16 on ImageNet 256 $\times$ 256. A raw patch is 768-dim ( $16{\times}16{\times}3$ ) and is embedded by two sequential linear layers with an intermediate bottleneck dimension $d^{\prime}$ ( $d^{\prime}<768$ ). Here, bottleneck embedding is generally beneficial , and our $\bm{x}$ -prediction model can work decently even with aggressive bottlenecks as small as 32 or 16. Settings (the same as [Tab. 3](#S4.T3) ): 200 epochs, with CFG.
units.zh: 图 4：瓶颈线性嵌入。结果为 ImageNet 256×256 上的 JiT-B/16。原始图块是 768 维（$16{\times}16{\times}3$），由两层顺序线性层嵌入，中间瓶颈维度为 $d^{\prime}$（$d^{\prime}<768$）。这里瓶颈嵌入总体有益，而且我们的 $\bm{x}$-预测模型即使使用小到 32 或 16 的激进瓶颈也能正常工作。设置（与表 3 相同）：200 轮，使用 CFG。

units.en: Bottleneck can be beneficial.
units.zh: 瓶颈可以带来收益。

units.en: Even more surprisingly, we find that, conversely, introducing a bottleneck that reduces dimensionality in the network can be beneficial.
units.zh: 更令人意外的是，我们发现反过来也成立：在网络中引入降低维度的瓶颈可以带来收益。

units.en: Specifically, we turn the linear patch embedding layer into a low-rank linear layer, by replacing it with a pair of bottleneck (yet still linear) layers. The first layer reduces the dimension to $d^{\prime}$ , and the second layer expands it to the hidden size of the Transformer. Both layers are linear and serve as a low-rank reparameterization.
units.zh: 具体来说，我们把线性的 patch 嵌入层变成低秩线性层，方法是将其替换为一对瓶颈（但仍然线性）的层。第一层把维度降到 $d^{\prime}$，第二层再扩展到 Transformer 的隐藏维度。两层都是线性的，构成一种低秩重参数化。

units.en: [Fig. 4](#S4.F4) plots the FID *vs* . the bottleneck dimension $d^{\prime}$ , using JiT-B/16 (768-d per raw patch). Reducing the bottleneck dimension, even to as small as 16-d, does not cause catastrophic failure. In fact, a bottleneck dimension across a wide range (32 to 512) can improve the quality, by a decent margin of up to $\scriptstyle\sim$ 1.3 FID.
units.zh: [图4](#S4.F4) 画出 FID 随瓶颈维度 $d^{\prime}$ 的变化，使用 JiT-B/16（每个原始 patch 768 维）。降低瓶颈维度，即使小到 16 维，也不会导致灾难性失败。事实上，瓶颈维度在很宽的范围（32 到 512）内都能提升质量，幅度可观，最高约 $\scriptstyle\sim$ 1.3 FID。

units.en: From a broader perspective of representation learning, this observation is not entirely unexpected. Bottleneck designs are often introduced to encourage the learning of inherently low-dimensional representations [ [64](#bib.bib58) , [48](#bib.bib59) , [41](#bib.bib60) , [2](#bib.bib61) ] .
units.zh: 从表征学习的更广视角看，这一观察并不完全出人意料。瓶颈设计常被引入以促进学习内在低维的表征 [64](#bib.bib58)、[48](#bib.bib59)、[41](#bib.bib60)、[2](#bib.bib61)。

units.en: Our final algorithm adopts $\bm{x}$ -prediction and $\bm{v}$ -loss, which corresponds to [Tab. 1](#S2.T1) (3)(a) . Formally, we optimize:
units.zh: 我们最终的算法采用 $\bm{x}$ 预测与 $\bm{v}$ 损失，对应[表1](#S2.T1)的 (3)(a)。形式上，我们优化：

units.en: $\displaystyle\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}_{t,\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon}}\Big\|\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{v}\Big\|^{2},$ (6) $\displaystyle\text{where:}\quad\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)=(\text{{net}}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t).$
units.zh: 这就是 JiT 的实际目标：网络输出干净图像 $\bm{x}_\theta=\text{net}_\theta(\bm{z}_t,t)$，再换算成 $\bm{v}_\theta$ 去匹配 $\bm{v}$，对应表 1 的 (3)(a)。下面的推导会说明，它等价于对 $\bm{x}$-MSE 乘权重 $1/(1-t)^2$。
units.note: 这就是 JiT 的实际目标：网络输出干净图像 $\bm{x}_\theta=\text{net}_\theta(\bm{z}_t,t)$，再换算成 $\bm{v}_\theta$ 去匹配 $\bm{v}$，对应表 1 的 (3)(a)。下面的推导会说明，它等价于对 $\bm{x}$-MSE 乘权重 $1/(1-t)^2$。

For brevity, class conditioning and CFG [ [22](#bib.bib14) ] are omitted, but both follow standard practice. To prevent zero division in $1{/}(1{-}t)$ , we clip its denominator (by default, 0.05) whenever computing this division.
units.zh: [算法1](#algorithm1) 给出一个训练步的伪代码，[算法2](#algorithm2) 是采样步的伪代码（欧拉求解器；可扩展到 Heun 或其他求解器）。为简洁起见，类别条件与 CFG [22](#bib.bib14) 被省略，但二者都遵循标准做法。为避免 $1{/}(1{-}t)$ 中的除零，我们在计算该除法时对其分母做裁剪（默认 0.05）。

units.en: 4.4 “Just Advanced” Transformers
units.zh: 4.4 “Just Advanced” Transformer（进阶版 Transformer）

units.en: The strength of a general-purpose Transformer [ [66](#bib.bib22) ] is partly in that, when its design is decoupled from the specific task, it can benefit from architectural advances developed in other applications. This property underpins the advantage of formulating diffusion with a task-agnostic Transformer.
units.zh: 通用 Transformer [66](#bib.bib22) 的优势部分在于：当其设计与具体任务解耦时，它可以受益于在其他应用中发展出来的架构进步。这一性质正是用任务无关的 Transformer 来表述扩散的优势所在。

units.en: Following [ [73](#bib.bib56) ] , we incorporate popular general-purpose improvements : SwiGLU [ [54](#bib.bib66) ] , RMSNorm [ [75](#bib.bib67) ] , RoPE [ [62](#bib.bib44) ] , qk-norm [ [19](#bib.bib65) ] , all of which were originally developed for language models. We also explore in-context class conditioning: but unlike original ViT [ [13](#bib.bib8) ] that appends one class token to the sequence, we appends multiple such tokens (by default, 32; see appendix), following [ [35](#bib.bib20) ] . [Tab. 4](#S5.T4) reports the effects of these components.
units.zh: 遵循 [73](#bib.bib56)，我们引入了流行的通用改进：SwiGLU [54](#bib.bib66)、RMSNorm [75](#bib.bib67)、RoPE [62](#bib.bib44)、qk-norm [19](#bib.bib65)，它们最初都是为语言模型开发的。我们还探索了 in-context 类别条件：但与原始 ViT [13](#bib.bib8) 在序列中追加一个类别 token 不同，我们追加多个这样的 token（默认 32 个；见附录），遵循 [35](#bib.bib20)。[表4](#S5.T4) 报告了这些组件的效果。

units.en: Scalability.
units.zh: 可扩展性。

units.en: A core goal of decoupling the Transformer design with the task is to leverage the potential for scalability. [Tab. 6](#S5.T6) provides results on ImageNet 256 and 512 with four model sizes (note that at resolution 512, none of these models have more hidden units than the patch dimension). The model sizes and flops are shown in [Tab. 8](#S5.T8) and [8](#S5.T8) : our model at resolution 256 has similar cost as its counterpart at 512. Our approach benefits from scaling.
units.zh: 将 Transformer 设计与任务解耦的一个核心目标，是利用可扩展性的潜力。[表6](#S5.T6)给出四种模型规模在 ImageNet 256 和 512 上的结果（注意在分辨率 512 下，这些模型的隐藏单元数都不超过 patch 维度）。模型规模与 FLOPs 见[表7](#S5.T7)和[表8](#S5.T8)：我们在分辨率 256 的模型与其 512 对应模型的代价相近。我们的方法受益于规模化。

units.en: Interestingly, the FID difference between resolution 256 and 512 becomes smaller with larger models. For JiT-G, the FID at 512 resolution is even lower. For very large models on ImageNet, FID performance largely depends on overfitting, and denoising at 512 resolution poses a more challenging task, making it less susceptible to overfitting.
units.zh: 有趣的是，分辨率 256 与 512 之间的 FID 差距随模型变大而缩小。对 JiT-G 而言，512 分辨率下的 FID 甚至更低。对 ImageNet 上的超大模型来说，FID 表现在很大程度上取决于过拟合，而 512 分辨率下的去噪是一个更难的任务，因此更不易过拟合。

Compared with other pixel-based methods, ours is purely driven by plain , general-purpose Transformers. Our models are compute-friendly and avoid the quadratic scaling of expense with doubled resolution (see flops in [Tab. 8](#S5.T8) ).

units.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
units.zh: 6 讨论与结论

units.en: Noise is inherently different from natural data . Over the years, the development of diffusion models has focused primarily on probabilistic formulations, while paying less attention to the capabilities (and limitations) of the neural networks used. However, neural networks are not infinitely capable, and they can better use their capacity to model data rather than noise. Under these perspectives, our findings on $\bm{x}$ -prediction are, in hindsight, a natural outcome.
units.zh: 噪声与自然数据本质上不同。多年来，扩散模型的发展主要集中于概率建模形式，而对所用神经网络的能力（及其局限）关注较少。然而，神经网络并非能力无限，它们可以更好地把容量用于建模数据而不是噪声。在这些视角下，我们关于 $\bm{x}$ 预测的发现，事后看来是自然的结果。

units.en: Our work adopts a minimalist and self-contained design. By reducing domain-specific inductive biases, we hope our approach can generalize to other domains where tokenizers are difficult to obtain. This property is particularly desirable for scientific applications that involve raw, high-dimensional natural data. We envision that the general-purpose “Diffusion + Transformer” paradigm will be a potential foundation in other areas.
units.zh: 我们的工作采用极简且自洽的设计。通过减少领域特定的归纳偏置，我们希望该方法能推广到难以获得 tokenizer 的其他领域。这一性质对涉及原始、高维自然数据的科学应用尤为可取。我们设想，通用的“扩散 + Transformer”范式有望成为其他领域的基础框架。

units.en: Appendix A Implementation Details
units.zh: 附录 A 实现细节

units.en: Our implementation closely follows the public codebases of DiT [ [46](#bib.bib12) ] and SiT [ [40](#bib.bib71) ] . Our configurations are summarized in [Tab. 9](#A1.T9) . We describe the details as follows.
units.zh: 我们的实现紧密遵循 DiT [[46](#bib.bib12)] 与 SiT [[40](#bib.bib71)] 的公开代码库。我们的配置汇总于 [表 9](#A1.T9)。细节描述如下。

units.en: Time distribution.
units.zh: 时间分布。

units.en: Following [ [15](#bib.bib31) ] , during training, we adopt the logit-normal distribution over $t$ [ [15](#bib.bib31) ] : $\text{logit}(t)\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^{2})$ . Specifically, we sample $s\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^{2})$ and let $t{=}\text{sigmoid}(s)$ . The hyper-parameter $\mu$ determines the noise level (see [Tab. 3](#S4.T3) ), and by default we set $\mu$ = –0.8 on ImageNet at resolution 256 (or 512, 1024), and fix $\sigma$ as 0.8.
units.zh: 遵循 [[15](#bib.bib31)]，训练时我们在 $t$ 上采用 logit-normal 分布 [[15](#bib.bib31)]：$\text{logit}(t)\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^{2})$。具体而言，我们采样 $s\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^{2})$ 并令 $t{=}\text{sigmoid}(s)$。超参数 $\mu$ 决定噪声水平（见 [表 3](#S4.T3)）；默认在 ImageNet 上对分辨率 256（或 512、1024）取 $\mu=-0.8$，并固定 $\sigma$ 为 0.8。

units.en: ImageNet 512 ${\times}$ 512 and 1024 ${\times}$ 1024.

We adopt JiT/32 ( *i.e* . , a patch size of 32) on ImageNet 512 ${\times}$ 512. The model leads to a sequence of 256 = 16 $\times$ 16 patches, the same as JiT/16 on ImageNet 256 ${\times}$ 256. As such, JiT/32 only differs from JiT/16 in the input/output patch dimension, increasing from 768-d to 3072-d per patch; all other computations and costs are exactly the same.
units.zh: 在 ImageNet 512 ${\times}$ 512 上我们采用 JiT/32（*即* patch 大小为 32）。模型得到 256 = 16 $\times$ 16 个 patch 的序列，与 ImageNet 256 ${\times}$ 256 上 JiT/16 的序列相同。因此，JiT/32 与 JiT/16 的唯一区别在于输入/输出 patch 的维度，由每 patch 768 维增至 3072 维；其余所有计算与开销完全一致。

units.en: To reuse the exact same recipe from ImageNet 256 ${\times}$ 256, for 512 ${\times}$ 512 images we rescale the magnitude of the noise $\bm{\epsilon}$ by 2 $\times$ : that is, $\bm{\epsilon}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,2^{2}\mathbf{I})$ . This simple modification approximately maintains the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) between the 256 ${\times}$ 256 and 512 ${\times}$ 512 resolutions [ [25](#bib.bib17) , [7](#bib.bib39) , [26](#bib.bib26) ] . No other changes to the ImageNet 256 ${\times}$ 256 configuration are required or applied.
units.zh: 为了复用 ImageNet 256 ${\times}$ 256 的完全相同配方，对 512 ${\times}$ 512 图像我们把噪声 $\bm{\epsilon}$ 的幅度放大 2 倍：即 $\bm{\epsilon}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,2^{2}\mathbf{I})$。这一简单改动近似保持了 256 ${\times}$ 256 与 512 ${\times}$ 512 分辨率之间的信噪比（SNR） [[25](#bib.bib17), [7](#bib.bib39), [26](#bib.bib26)]。ImageNet 256 ${\times}$ 256 的配置不需要、也没有施加任何其他改动。

units.en: For ImageNet 1024 ${\times}$ 1024, we use the model JiT/64 and scale the noise $\bm{\epsilon}$ by 4 $\times$ . No other change is needed.
units.zh: 对 ImageNet 1024 ${\times}$ 1024，我们使用 JiT/64 模型，并把噪声 $\bm{\epsilon}$ 放大 4 $\times$。无需其他改动。

units.en: In-context class conditioning.
units.zh: 上下文内类别条件。

units.en: Standard DiT [ [46](#bib.bib12) ] performs class conditioning through adaLN-Zero. In [Tab. 4](#S5.T4) , we further explore in-context class-conditioning.
units.zh: 标准 DiT [[46](#bib.bib12)] 通过 adaLN-Zero 实现类别条件。在 [表 4](#S5.T4) 中，我们进一步探索了上下文内（in-context）类别条件。

units.en: Specifically, following ViT [ [13](#bib.bib8) ] , one can prepend a class token to the sequence of patches. This is referred to as “in-context conditioning” in DiT [ [46](#bib.bib12) ] . Note that we use in-context conditioning jointly with the default adaLN-Zero conditioning, unlike DiT. In addition, following MAR [ [35](#bib.bib20) ] , we further prepend multiple such tokens to the sequence. These tokens are repeated instances of the same class token, with different positional embeddings added. We prepend 32 such tokens. Moreover, rather than prepending these tokens to the Transformer’s input, we find that prepending them at later blocks can be beneficial (see “in-context start block” in [Tab. 9](#A1.T9) ). [Tab. 4](#S5.T4) shows that our implementation of in-context conditioning improves FID by $\scriptstyle\sim$ 1.2.
units.zh: 具体而言，遵循 ViT [[13](#bib.bib8)]，可以把一个类别 token 前置到 patch 序列之前。DiT [[46](#bib.bib12)] 称之为“上下文内条件”（in-context conditioning）。注意，与 DiT 不同，我们把这套上下文内条件与默认的 adaLN-Zero 条件**联合**使用。此外，遵循 MAR [[35](#bib.bib20)]，我们进一步向序列前置多个这样的 token。这些 token 是同一类别 token 的重复实例，各自加上不同的位置编码。我们前置 32 个这样的 token。并且，我们不是把这些 token 前置到 Transformer 的输入端，而是发现在更靠后的 block 处前置它们可能更有利（见 [表 9](#A1.T9) 中的“in-context start block”）。[表 4](#S5.T4) 显示，我们的上下文内条件实现把 FID 改善了约 1.2。

units.en: Table 9 : Configurations of experiments.
units.zh: 表 9：实验配置。

units.en: Figure 6 : The influence of CFG, without and with CFG interval (for JiT-L/16 on ImageNet 256 $\times$ 256, 600 epochs).
units.zh: 图 6：CFG 的影响，分别在不使用和使用 CFG interval 的情况下（JiT-L/16，ImageNet 256×256，600 轮）。

units.en: Dropout and early stop.
units.zh: Dropout 与早停。

units.en: We apply dropout [ [61](#bib.bib76) ] in JiT-H and G to mitigate the risk of overfitting. Specifically, we apply dropout to the middle half of the Transformer blocks. For Transformer blocks with dropout, we apply it to both the attention block and the MLP block.
units.zh: 我们在 JiT-H 与 JiT-G 中应用 dropout [[61](#bib.bib76)] 以缓解过拟合风险。具体而言，我们对 Transformer block 的中间一半施加 dropout。对这些带 dropout 的 Transformer block，我们在 attention block 与 MLP block 上都施加。

units.en: As the G-size models still tend to overfit under our current dropout setting, we apply early stopping when the monitored FID begins to degrade. This occurs at around 320 epochs for both JiT-G/16 and JiT-G/32.
units.zh: 由于 G 规模模型在我们当前的 dropout 设置下仍倾向于过拟合，当监控的 FID 开始变差时我们启用早停。对 JiT-G/16 与 JiT-G/32，这大约发生在 320 个 epoch。

units.en: EMA and CFG.
units.zh: EMA 与 CFG。

units.en: Our study covers a wide range of configurations, including variations in loss and prediction spaces, model sizes, and architectural components. The optimal values of the CFG scale [ [22](#bib.bib14) ] and EMA (exponential moving average) decay vary from case to case, and fixing them may lead to incomplete or misleading observations. Since maintaining these hyperparameter configurations is relatively inexpensive, we strive to adopt the optimal values.
units.zh: 我们的研究覆盖很宽的配置范围，包括损失与预测空间的变体、模型规模以及架构组件。CFG scale [[22](#bib.bib14)] 与 EMA（指数滑动平均）衰减的最优值因情形而异，固定它们可能带来不完整或有误导性的观察结果。由于维护这些超参数配置的成本相对较低，我们力求采用最优值。

units.en: Specifically, for the CFG scale $\omega$ [ [22](#bib.bib14) ] , we determine the optimal value by searching over a range of candidate scales at inference time, as is common practice in existing work. For EMA decays, we maintain multiple copies of the moving-averaged parameters during training, which introduces a negligible computational overhead. To avoid memory overhead, different EMA copies can be stored on separate devices ( *e.g* . , GPUs). As such, both the CFG scale and EMA decay are essentially inference-time decisions.
units.zh: 具体而言，对 CFG scale $\omega$ [[22](#bib.bib14)]，我们按照现有工作的常见做法，在推理时于一组候选 scale 上搜索以确定最优值。对 EMA 衰减，我们在训练期间维护多份滑动平均参数的副本，这引入的计算开销可忽略。为避免内存开销，不同的 EMA 副本可以存放在不同设备（*例如* GPU）上。因此，CFG scale 与 EMA 衰减本质上都是推理时的决定。

units.en: Our CFG scale candidates range from 1.0 to 4.0 with a step size of 0.1. The influence of CFG is shown in [Fig. 6](#A1.F6) for a JiT-L/16 model. Our EMA decay candidates are 0.9996, 0.9998, and 0.9999, evaluated with a batch size of 1024. For each model (including any one in the ablation), we search for the optimal setting using 8K samples and then apply it to evaluate 50K samples.
units.zh: 我们的 CFG scale 候选从 1.0 到 4.0、步长 0.1。以 JiT-L/16 模型展示的 CFG 影响见 [图 6](#A1.F6)。我们的 EMA 衰减候选为 0.9996、0.9998 与 0.9999，以批大小 1024 评估。对每个模型（包括消融中的任意一个），我们用 8K 样本搜索最优设置，再将其用于评估 50K 样本。

units.en: Evaluation.
units.zh: 评估。

units.en: Following common pratice, we evaluate the FID [ [21](#bib.bib78) ] against the ImageNet training set. We evaluate FID on 50K generated images, with 50 samples for each of the 1000 ImageNet classes. We evaluate the Inception Score (IS) [ [53](#bib.bib79) ] on the same 50K images.
units.zh: 遵循常见做法，我们针对 ImageNet 训练集评估 FID [[21](#bib.bib78)]。我们在 50K 张生成图像上评估 FID，1000 个 ImageNet 类别每类 50 张样本。我们在同一批 50K 图像上评估 Inception Score（IS）[[53](#bib.bib79)]。

units.en: In [Tab. 2](#S4.T2) (a), the failure of $\bm{\epsilon}$ -/ $\bm{v}$ -prediction is caused by the inherent incapability of predicting a high-dimensional output from a limited-capacity network. This failure can be seen from the training loss curves.

units.en: In [Fig. 7](#A2.F7) (top), we compare the training loss curves under the same $\bm{v}$ -loss, defined as $\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}\|\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{v}\|^{2}$ , using $\bm{v}$ -prediction ( *i.e* . , $\bm{v}_{\theta}=\text{{net}}_{\theta}$ ) versus $\bm{x}$ -prediction ( *i.e* . , $\bm{v}_{\theta}=(\text{{net}}_{\theta}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)$ ). Since the loss is computed in the same space and only the parameterization differs, comparing the loss values is legitimate.
units.zh: 在 [图 7](#A2.F7)（上）中，我们在相同的 $\bm{v}$-损失下比较训练损失曲线，该损失定义为 $\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}\|\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{v}\|^{2}$，分别使用 $\bm{v}$-预测（*即* $\bm{v}_{\theta}=\text{net}_{\theta}$）与 $\bm{x}$-预测（*即* $\bm{v}_{\theta}=(\text{net}_{\theta}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)$）。由于损失在同一空间中计算、只有参数化方式不同，比较损失值是有依据的。

units.en: [Fig. 7](#A2.F7) (top) shows that $\bm{v}$ -prediction yields substantially higher loss values (about 25%) than $\bm{x}$ -prediction, even though $\bm{v}$ -prediction appears to be the “native” parameterization for the $\bm{v}$ -loss. This comparison indicates that the task of $\bm{x}$ -prediction is inherently easier , as the data lie on a low-dimensional manifold. We also observe that $\bm{\epsilon}$ -prediction (not shown here) has about $3\times$ higher loss and is unstable, which may explain its failure in [Tab. 2](#S4.T2) (a).
units.zh: [图 7](#A2.F7)（上）显示，$\bm{v}$-预测的损失值显著高于 $\bm{x}$-预测（约高 25%），尽管 $\bm{v}$-预测看起来是 $\bm{v}$-损失的“原生”参数化。这一比较表明，$\bm{x}$-预测的任务**本身更容易**，因为数据位于低维流形上。我们还观察到 $\bm{\epsilon}$-预测（此处未画出）的损失约高 3 倍且不稳定，这或许能解释它在 [表 2](#S4.T2) (a) 中的失败。

The higher loss of $\bm{v}$ -prediction in [Fig. 7](#A2.F7) (top) can be reflected by its noticeable artifacts in [Fig. 7](#A2.F7) (bottom).
units.zh: [图 7](#A2.F7)（下）比较了对应两条训练曲线的**去噪**图像。对 $\bm{x}$-预测，去噪图像就是 $\bm{x}_{\theta}=\text{net}_{\theta}$；对 $\bm{v}$-预测，去噪图像为 $\bm{x}_{\theta}{=}(1{-}t)\text{net}_{\theta}{+}\bm{z}_{t}$，其中 $\bm{v}_{\theta}{=}\text{net}_{\theta}$（见 [表 1](#S2.T1) (c)(1)）。$\bm{v}$-预测在 [图 7](#A2.F7)（上）中更高的损失，可以从它在 [图 7](#A2.F7)（下）中明显的**伪影**看出来。

units.en: Note that the artifact in [Fig. 7](#A2.F7) (bottom) is that of a single denoising step. In the generation process, this error can accumulate in the multi-step ODE solver, which leads to the catastrophic failure in [Tab. 2](#S4.T2) (a).
units.zh: 注意 [图 7](#A2.F7)（下）中的伪影只是**单步**去噪的伪影。在生成过程中，这一误差会在多步 ODE 求解器中累积，从而导致 [表 2](#S4.T2) (a) 中的灾难性失败。

units.en: B.2 Pre-conditioner
units.zh: B.2 预条件器

units.en: In EDM [ [29](#bib.bib30) ] , an extra “pre-conditioner” is applied to wrap the direct output of the network. Using the notation of our paper, the pre-conditioner formulation can be written as: $\bm{x}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)=c_{\text{skip}}\cdot\bm{z}_{t}+c_{\text{out}}\cdot\text{{net}}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)$ , where $c_{\text{skip}}$ and $c_{\text{out}}$ are pre-defined coefficients. This equation suggests that unless $c_{\text{skip}}\equiv 0$ , the network output in a pre-conditioner must not perform $\bm{x}$ -prediction. And according to the manifold assumption, this formulation should not remedy the issue we consider, as we examine next.
units.zh: 在 EDM [[29](#bib.bib30)] 中，额外的“预条件器”（pre-conditioner）被用来包裹网络的直接输出。用本文记号，预条件器的形式可写为：$\bm{x}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)=c_{\text{skip}}\cdot\bm{z}_{t}+c_{\text{out}}\cdot\text{net}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)$，其中 $c_{\text{skip}}$ 与 $c_{\text{out}}$ 是预定义系数。该式表明，**除非** $c_{\text{skip}}\equiv 0$，预条件器中的网络输出必定**不**执行 $\bm{x}$-预测。而根据流形假设，这种形式不应能解决我们所考虑的问题，下面我们对此加以检验。

units.en: Formulation of pre-conditioners.
units.zh: 预条件器的形式。

units.en: Given the definition of pre-conditioner, we can rewrite the “pre-conditioned $\bm{x}$ -prediction” as:
units.zh: 给定预条件器的定义，我们可以把“预条件化的 $\bm{x}$-预测”改写为：

units.en: $\left\{\begin{aligned} \bm{x}_{\theta}&=c_{\text{skip}}\cdot\bm{z}_{t}+c_{\text{out}}\cdot\text{{net}}_{\theta}\\ \bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}&=(\bm{z}_{t}-t\bm{x}_{\theta})/(1-t)\\ \bm{v}_{\theta}&=(\bm{x}_{\theta}-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)\end{aligned}\right.$ (7)
units.zh: 预条件器把网络输出包一层：$\bm{x}_\theta=c_{\text{skip}}\bm{z}_t+c_{\text{out}}\text{net}_\theta$，再由 $\bm{x}_\theta$ 推出 $\bm{\epsilon}_\theta$ 与 $\bm{v}_\theta$。当 $c_{\text{skip}}=0,c_{\text{out}}=1$ 时退化为直接 $\bm{x}$-预测；否则网络只承担残差。
units.note: 预条件器把网络输出包一层：$\bm{x}_\theta=c_{\text{skip}}\bm{z}_t+c_{\text{out}}\text{net}_\theta$，再由 $\bm{x}_\theta$ 推出 $\bm{\epsilon}_\theta$ 与 $\bm{v}_\theta$。当 $c_{\text{skip}}=0,c_{\text{out}}=1$ 时退化为直接 $\bm{x}$-预测；否则网络只承担残差。

units.en: Accordingly, the objective in [Eq. 6](#S4.E6) ( $\bm{v}$ -loss) is written as:
units.zh: 相应地，[式 6](#S4.E6)（$\bm{v}$-损失）中的目标写作：

units.en: $\displaystyle\mathcal{L}=\mathbb{E}_{t,\bm{x},\bm{\epsilon}}\Big\|\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{v}\Big\|^{2},$ (8) $\displaystyle\text{where:}\quad\bm{v}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)=(\bm{x}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)-\bm{z}_{t})/(1-t)$ $\displaystyle\text{and}\quad\bm{x}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t)=c_{\text{skip}}\cdot\bm{z}_{t}+c_{\text{out}}\cdot\text{{net}}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t).$
units.zh: 把预条件器代入同一个 $\bm{v}$-损失，得到这条式子。损失形式没变，变的是 $\bm{x}_\theta$ 如何由网络输出构造；表 10 比较的正是这几种构造。
units.note: 把预条件器代入同一个 $\bm{v}$-损失，得到这条式子。损失形式没变，变的是 $\bm{x}_\theta$ 如何由网络输出构造；表 10 比较的正是这几种构造。

units.en: Comparing with [Eq. 6](#S4.E6) , the only difference is in how we compute $\bm{x}_{\theta}$ from the network.
units.zh: 与 [式 6](#S4.E6) 相比，唯一的区别在于我们如何由网络计算 $\bm{x}_{\theta}$。

units.en: Table 10 : Comparisons with pre-conditioners (FID-50K, ImageNet 256, JiT-B/16). The settings are the same as [Tab. 2](#S4.T2) (a).
units.zh: 表 10：与预条件器的比较（FID-50K，ImageNet 256，JiT-B/16）。设置与表 2(a) 相同。

units.en: As EDM [ [29](#bib.bib30) ] uses a variance-exploding schedule (that is, $\bm{z}_{t}{=}\bm{x}{+}\sigma_{t}\bm{\epsilon}$ ) and we use a (roughly) variance-preserving version (that is, $\bm{z}_{t}{=}t\bm{x}{+}(1{-}t)\bm{\epsilon}$ ), a fully equivalent conversion is impossible. To have a pre-conditioner in our case, we rewrite our version as $\frac{1}{t}\bm{z}_{t}=\bm{x}+\frac{1-t}{t}\bm{\epsilon}$ . As such, we set $\sigma_{t}=\frac{1-t}{t}$ , which is the noise added to unscaled images, similar to EDM’s. With this, we can rewrite the coefficients defined by EDM [ [29](#bib.bib30) ] as: $c_{\text{skip}}=\frac{1}{t}\frac{\sigma_{\text{data}}^{2}}{\sigma_{\text{data}}^{2}+\sigma_{t}^{2}}$ and $c_{\text{out}}=\frac{\sigma_{\text{data}}\sigma_{t}}{\sqrt{\sigma_{\text{data}}^{2}+\sigma_{t}^{2}}}$ where $\sigma_{\text{data}}$ is the data standard deviation set as 0.5 [ [29](#bib.bib30) ] . We choose $c_{\text{in}}=t$ ( $=\frac{1}{\sigma_{t}+1}$ ), so that the direct input to the network ( *i.e* . , $c_{\text{in}}\cdot\frac{1}{t}z_{t}$ ) is still $z_{t}$ . It can be shown that only when $t\rightarrow 0$ , we have: $\sigma_{t}{\rightarrow}+\infty$ , $c_{\text{skip}}{\rightarrow}0$ , $c_{\text{out}}{\rightarrow}1$ , which approaches $\bm{x}$ -prediction. We also consider a simpler linear pre-conditioner: $c_{\text{skip}}=t$ and $c_{\text{out}}=1-t$ , which also performs $\bm{x}$ -prediction only when $t=0$ .
units.zh: 由于 EDM [[29](#bib.bib30)] 使用方差爆炸（variance-exploding）调度（即 $\bm{z}_{t}{=}\bm{x}{+}\sigma_{t}\bm{\epsilon}$），而我们使用（大致）方差保持的版本（即 $\bm{z}_{t}{=}t\bm{x}{+}(1{-}t)\bm{\epsilon}$），完全等价的转换是不可能的。为了在我们的情形下得到预条件器，我们把我们的版本改写为 $\frac{1}{t}\bm{z}_{t}=\bm{x}+\frac{1-t}{t}\bm{\epsilon}$。因此我们设 $\sigma_{t}=\frac{1-t}{t}$，这是加到未缩放图像上的噪声，与 EDM 类似。由此，我们可以把 EDM [[29](#bib.bib30)] 定义的系数改写为：$c_{\text{skip}}=\frac{1}{t}\frac{\sigma_{\text{data}}^{2}}{\sigma_{\text{data}}^{2}+\sigma_{t}^{2}}$ 与 $c_{\text{out}}=\frac{\sigma_{\text{data}}\sigma_{t}}{\sqrt{\sigma_{\text{data}}^{2}+\sigma_{t}^{2}}}$，其中 $\sigma_{\text{data}}$ 是数据标准差，设为 0.5 [[29](#bib.bib30)]。我们选择 $c_{\text{in}}=t$（$=\frac{1}{\sigma_{t}+1}$），使得送入网络的直接输入（*即* $c_{\text{in}}\cdot\frac{1}{t}z_{t}$）仍然是 $z_{t}$。可以证明，**只有**当 $t\rightarrow 0$ 时，才有：$\sigma_{t}{\rightarrow}+\infty$、$c_{\text{skip}}{\rightarrow}0$、$c_{\text{out}}{\rightarrow}1$，此时它趋近 $\bm{x}$-预测。我们还考虑一个更简单的**线性**预条件器：$c_{\text{skip}}=t$ 与 $c_{\text{out}}=1-t$，它也**只在** $t=0$ 时执行 $\bm{x}$-预测。

units.en: Results of pre-conditioners.
units.zh: 预条件器的结果。

units.en: [Tab. 10](#A2.T10) shows that the pre-conditioned versions all fail catastrophically, suggesting that deviating from $\bm{x}$ -prediction is not desired in high-dimensional spaces. Interestingly, the pre-conditioned versions are much better than $\bm{\epsilon}$ -/ $\bm{v}$ -prediction in [Tab. 2](#S4.T2) (a). We hypothesize that this is because they are more similar to $\bm{x}$ -prediction when $t{\rightarrow}0$ , which alleviates this issue.
units.zh: [表 10](#A2.T10) 显示，预条件化的各个版本都灾难性地失败，这表明在高维空间中偏离 $\bm{x}$-预测并不可取。有趣的是，这些预条件化版本远好于 [表 2](#S4.T2) (a) 中的 $\bm{\epsilon}$-/ $\bm{v}$-预测。我们推测，这是因为它们在 $t{\rightarrow}0$ 时更接近 $\bm{x}$-预测，从而缓解了该问题。

units.en: B.3 Exploration: Classification Loss
units.zh: B.3 探索：分类损失

units.en: Our paper focuses on a minimalist design, and we intentionally do not use any extra loss. However, we note that latent-based methods [ [49](#bib.bib7) ] typically rely on tokenizers trained with adversarial and perceptual losses, and thus their generation process is not purely driven by diffusion. Next, we discuss a simple extension on our pixel-based models with an additional classification loss.
units.zh: 本文聚焦极简设计，我们有意**不**使用任何额外损失。但需要说明，基于潜空间的方法 [[49](#bib.bib7)] 通常依赖用**对抗**损失与**感知**损失训练的 tokenizer，因此它们的生成过程并非纯粹由扩散驱动。接下来，我们讨论在像素空间模型上的一个简单扩展：额外的分类损失。

units.en: Table 11 : Exploration: additional classification loss . We do not use this loss in any other experiments. Settings: ImageNet 256 $\times$ 256, 200-ep, with CFG interval.
units.zh: 表 11：探索：额外的分类损失。我们在其他任何实验中都不使用该损失。设置：ImageNet 256×256，200 轮，使用 CFG interval。

units.en: Formally, we attach a classifier head after a specific Transformer block (the 4th in JiT-B and the 8th in JiT-L). The classifier consists of global average pooling followed by a linear layer, and a cross-entropy loss is applied for the 1000-class ImageNet classification task. This classification loss $\mathcal{L}_{\text{cls}}$ is scaled by a weight $\lambda$ ( *e.g* . , $100$ ) and added to the $\ell_{2}$ -based ( *i.e* . , element-wise sum of squared errors) regression loss. To prevent label leakage, we disable class conditioning for all layers before the classifier head. We note that this modification remains minimal and does not rely on any pre-trained classifier, unlike the perceptual loss [ [76](#bib.bib1) ] . This minor modification leads to a decent improvement, as shown in [Tab. 11](#A2.T11) . This exploration suggests further potential for combining our simple method with additional loss terms, which we leave for future work.
units.zh: 形式上，我们在某个特定 Transformer block 之后接一个分类头（JiT-B 中为第 4 个 block，JiT-L 中为第 8 个）。分类器由全局平均池化接一个线性层组成，并对 1000 类 ImageNet 分类任务施加交叉熵损失。该分类损失 $\mathcal{L}_{\text{cls}}$ 以权重 $\lambda$（*例如* $100$）缩放后，加到基于 $\ell_{2}$（即逐元素平方误差之和）的回归损失上。为防止标签泄漏，我们在分类头之前的所有层关闭类别条件。我们注意到，这一改动仍然很小，且不依赖任何预训练分类器，与感知损失 [[76](#bib.bib1)] 不同。如 [表 11](#A2.T11) 所示，这一微小改动带来了不错的提升。这一探索表明，我们的简单方法还有与额外损失项结合的进一步潜力，我们将其留待未来工作。

units.en: Despite the improvement, we do not use this or any additional loss in the other experiments presented in this paper.
units.zh: 尽管有提升，在本文呈现的其他实验中，我们**不**使用该损失、也不使用任何额外损失。

units.en: B.4 Cross-resolution Generation
units.zh: B.4 跨分辨率生成

units.en: A model trained at one resolution can be applied to another by simply downsampling or upsampling the generated images. We refer to this as cross-resolution generation. In our setup, JiT/16 at 256 and JiT/32 at 512 have comparable parameters and compute, making their cross-resolution comparison meaningful. The results are in [Tab. 12](#A2.T12)
units.zh: 在一个分辨率上训练的模型，可以通过对生成图像简单下采样或上采样，应用于另一分辨率。我们称其为**跨分辨率**生成。在我们的设置中，在 256 分辨率训练的 JiT/16 与在 512 分辨率训练的 JiT/32 具有可比的参数量和计算量，使它们的跨分辨率比较有意义。结果见 [表 12](#A2.T12)。

units.en: Table 12 : Cross-resolution Generation (noted in gray), using JiT-G/16 trained at resolution 256 and JiT-G/32 trained at 512, followed by upsampling ( $\uparrow$ ) or downsampling ( $\downarrow$ ). All entries have similar parameters and flops (see [Tab. 8](#S5.T8) and [8](#S5.T8) ).
units.zh: 表 12：跨分辨率生成（灰色标出），使用在 256 分辨率训练的 JiT-G/16 与在 512 训练的 JiT-G/32，随后进行上采样（↑）或下采样（↓）。所有条目参数量与 flops 相近（见表 7 和表 8）。

units.en: Downsampling the images generated by the 512 model to 256 resolution yields a decent FID@256 of 1.84. This result remains competitive when compared with the 256-resolution expert (FID@256 of 1.82), while maintaining a similar computational cost and gaining the additional ability to generate at 512 resolution.
units.zh: 把 512 模型生成的图像**下采样**到 256 分辨率，得到 1.84 的 FID@256，表现不错。与 256 分辨率专家模型（FID@256 为 1.82）相比，这一结果仍有竞争力，同时保持相近的计算成本，并额外获得在 512 分辨率生成的能力。

units.en: On the other hand, upsampling the images generated by the 256 model to 512 resolution results in a noticeably worse FID@512 of 2.45, compared with the 512-resolution expert’s FID@512 of 1.78. This degradation is caused by the loss of higher-frequency details due to upsampling.
units.zh: 另一方面，把 256 模型生成的图像**上采样**到 512 分辨率，得到明显更差的 FID@512：2.45，而 512 分辨率专家的 FID@512 为 1.78。这一退化源于上采样造成的高频细节丢失。
